en.完成那一拍取走队首；下一拍才会出现下一个字节。: Accept the queue head on the completion tick; the next byte appears on the following tick.
en.来源按握手逐个提供字节；这让帧的数据部分不必预先把所有字节都放进寄存卡。: A source supplies bytes one at a time through a handshake; the data section need not put every byte into a register in advance.
en.把起始位、11 位标识符、控制位、4 位数据长度、数据和 15 位 CRC 依次: Send the start bit, 11-bit identifier, control bits, four-bit data length, data and 15-bit CRC in order. Stuffing applies to original bits from start through CRC; then send the CRC delimiter, ACK slot, ACK delimiter, end of frame and intermission.
en.本关的标识符和长度在整帧期间保持不变；数据由队列逐字节提供，队首标志指出最后一个: In this level the identifier and length remain fixed throughout the frame. Data comes one byte at a time from a queue whose last flag marks its final byte. The sender releases the ACK slot so another node can pull it low.
en.分阶段生成原始位：起始、标识符、三个控制位、长度、数据、CRC；用逐位送字段和队: Generate original bits in phases: start, identifier, three control bits, length, data and CRC. Reuse the field sender and queue handshake.
en.CRC 只收起始到数据末尾被取走的原始位。数据最后一位被取走时保存它，随后按 1: CRC accepts only original bits from start through the end of data. Save it when the last data bit is accepted, or at the end of length for zero bytes; then send its 15 bits.
en.CRC 的最后一位可能还欠一个填充位；先发完它，再按实际拍数发送界定、应答、帧结: The last CRC bit may still owe a stuff bit. Send it first, then count actual ticks through delimiters, ACK, end of frame and intermission.
en.发送方在应答位不拉低总线；有没有其他节点应答，要在听的阶段读回实际总线。: The sender releases the bus in the ACK slot; whether another node acknowledges must be read back in the hearing phase.
en.同一拍里，节点说出的位与总线上听到的位可能不同。发送方在应答位说隐性；若有接收方: Within one tick the bit a node says can differ from what it hears on the bus. The sender says recessive in the ACK slot; a receiver that accepted the frame pulls the bus dominant.
en.用搭好的发送器发一帧，同时逐拍交出实际听到的总线位。测试包含有应答和没有应答两种: Use your transmitter to send one frame and also give the actual bus bit each tick. Tests include both acknowledged and unacknowledged frames; take each queue byte at its last original bit.
en.应答位是否被拉低来自其他节点；只看发送方自己说的位无法知道有没有接收方应答。: The ACK slot is pulled low by another node. Looking only at what the sender says cannot show whether a receiver acknowledged.
en.两个节点同时开始说话时，不需要先商量：它们一位一位地说标识符，也同时听总线。说隐: When nodes start together, they need no prior negotiation: each sends its identifier one bit at a time while listening to the bus. A node that says recessive 1 but hears dominant 0 loses and releases the bus from the next tick.
en.只有仲裁段中的这种差异代表仲裁落败。应答位或数据段也可能听到不同的位，不能把这些: Only this difference in the arbitration field means arbitration was lost. A different bit can also be heard in the ACK or data field; those must not all be called arbitration loss.
en.「待发送位」给出本节点原本准备说的帧位，「仲裁段」标出正在仲裁的拍。「开始」先清: Intended bit gives the bit this node planned to send; Arbitration marks the arbitration ticks. Start clears the loss state first. Drive the bus each tick; Lost is 1 from the tick arbitration is lost, and the node says 1 from the next tick.
en.先根据寄存卡里上一拍是否落败，决定这一拍说原位还是放开总线。: Use the register’s previous loss state to choose this tick’s intended bit or release.
en.听到本拍总线后，只在仲裁段比较自己说的与听到的；说 1 而听到 0 就记下落败。: After hearing the bus, compare what you said with what you heard only during arbitration; remember a loss when you said 1 and heard 0.
en.说和听分成两半：这一拍的听到只能改变下一拍的发送，不能接回本拍的说话口。: Speaking and hearing are separate phases: what is heard now can change the next tick, not the current sending port.
en.标识符较小的帧在第一个不同位说 0，继续发送；输了的节点从下一拍退出，不破坏赢家: The lower identifier says 0 at the first different bit and keeps sending. The loser withdraws on the next tick without disturbing the winner’s bit.
en.从待发送位和仲裁段标志决定驱动；仲裁段说 1 却听到 0 时记下落败，下一拍起放: Drives intended bits during arbitration; if it says 1 but hears 0 in the arbitration field, it records a loss and releases the bus from the next tick. Start resets it.
en.把仲裁元件放进自己的节点。竞争者也会听到总线：它们一旦在仲裁段落败，就在下一拍退: Put the arbitration part in your node. Competitors listen too: once they lose arbitration, they withdraw on the next tick.
en.用搭好的仲裁元件驱动总线并交出落败状态；同时交出实际听到的总线。测试包含竞争者先: Use your arbitration part to drive the bus and give the loss state; also give the actual bus bit. Tests include both a competitor losing first and your node losing first.
en.所有竞争者逐拍做同一个比较；没有中央节点逐个发号施令。: Every competitor performs the same comparison each tick; no central node issues commands one by one.
en.仲裁落败并不表示总线停了：赢家还在继续发送。输的一方要从发送转为监听，把赢家的帧: Losing arbitration does not stop the bus: the winner continues sending. The loser must switch from transmitting to listening and receive the winner’s frame.
en.节点从空闲后开始竞争。落败后放开总线，并在赢家标识符的最后一位交出该标识符；没有: The node competes after an idle period. After losing, release the bus and give the winner’s identifier on its final original bit; give no identifier if this node did not lose. Give the loss state each tick.
en.让仲裁元件控制说话口；同时让校验抓帧器一直听实际总线。: Let the arbitration part control the sending port while the checked capture device listens to the actual bus.
en.只在已落败时转交抓帧器读出的标识符。: Pass through the identifier read by the capture device only after this node has lost.
en.输掉仲裁不会破坏赢家的帧；转为接收后，输的一方仍能听懂赢家说的内容。: Losing arbitration does not damage the winner’s frame. Once the loser becomes a receiver it can still understand what the winner sent.
en.落败后不能只收标识符：还要收长度与每个数据字节，并检查 CRC。正确接收的节点会: After losing, receive more than the identifier: take the length and every data byte and check CRC. A node that received the frame correctly says dominant in the following ACK slot.
en.竞争后若本节点落败，接收赢家的标识符、长度、每个字节和校验结果；赢家帧校验正确时: If this node loses arbitration, receive the winner’s identifier, length, each byte and check result; if the check passes, say 0 in the ACK slot. Do not give these received values when this node did not lose. Give the loss state each tick.
en.让校验抓帧器持续听总线，用它的「结果就绪」识别 CRC 界定位。: Keep the checked capture device listening; use Result ready to recognise the CRC delimiter.
en.校验结果为是且已经落败时，记下需要应答；下一拍从寄存卡驱动显性 0。: When the check is yes and this node has lost, remember that an ACK is needed; drive dominant 0 from the register on the next tick.
en.只在落败时转交抓帧器的字段和校验结果。: Pass through capture fields and check result only after losing.
en.在仲裁后转为接收，正确接收时应答；应答位比 CRC 界定位晚一拍，不能用本拍听到: After losing arbitration, become a receiver and acknowledge a correctly received frame. ACK is one tick after the CRC delimiter, so what is heard now cannot drive the bus in the same tick.
en.仲裁输了之后，自己的帧还没有送出去。先收下赢家并在正确接收时应答，再等帧间隔结束: After losing arbitration, the node has not sent its frame. Receive and acknowledge the winner if correct, then wait for intermission and an idle bus before sending the original frame again.
en.「开始」时尝试发送自己的标准帧。若仲裁落败，接收并应答赢家，等待至少 11 位连: On Start, attempt to send your standard frame. After losing arbitration, receive and acknowledge the winner, wait for at least 11 consecutive recessive bits, then retransmit; if you win initially, do not retry. Take each queued byte only when your own byte has actually been sent.
en.用发送器的「仲裁段」和说出的位接仲裁元件；落败后屏蔽数据队列的可用信号，不能提前: Connect the sender’s arbitration flag and intended bit to the arbiter. While waiting after loss, hide queue availability so your bytes cannot be consumed early.
en.让抓帧器持续监听，正确接收赢家后在下一拍应答。: Keep the capture device listening and acknowledge a correctly received winner on the next tick.
en.落败时数总线的连续隐性位；数够 11 位后重新启动发送器和仲裁元件。: After losing, count consecutive recessive bus bits; restart the transmitter and arbiter once the count reaches 11.
en.仲裁失败不是发送错误：赢家不受打断，输家保留待发数据并在总线空闲后再试。: Arbitration loss is not a transmission error: the winner is not interrupted, and the loser retains its pending data and tries again when the bus is idle.
en.我说的不是我听到的: What I said is not what I heard
en.节点发送时也会读回总线。仲裁段说 1 听到 0 是落败；应答位说 1 听到 0: A node reads the bus while transmitting. In arbitration, saying 1 and hearing 0 means loss; in the ACK slot it may be a receiver acknowledging. Elsewhere, a difference between the sent and sampled bit is a bit error.
en.按「待发送位」驱动总线。除「仲裁段」和「应答位」之外，若听到的位与说的不同，把「: Drive Intended bit onto the bus. Outside Arbitration and ACK, retain Error as 1 if the heard bit differs from the sent bit; Start clears the error first. Tests invert the sampled bus on specified ticks.
en.先比较说出的位和听到的总线位；只在仲裁段和应答位都为 0 时把差异当作位错误。: Compare the sent bit with the bus; treat a difference as a bit error only when both Arbitration and ACK are 0.
en.用寄存卡保持错误；开始时先清零。: Use a register to retain the error and clear it first on Start.
en.应答和仲裁有各自的解释；其他位置的读回不符表示发送方观察到了位错误。: ACK and arbitration have their own meanings; elsewhere a readback mismatch means the transmitter observed a bit error.
en.主动错误节点发现错误后，要让别的节点也看见。它从下一拍起连续说六位显性，故意违反: After detecting an error, an error-active node must make it visible to others. From the next tick it sends six dominant bits, deliberately violating normal frame stuffing; eight recessive error-delimiter bits follow.
en.「错误」为 1 的下一拍开始说六个 0，再说八个 1；八位界定的最后一拍让「完成: On the tick after Error is 1, send six 0 bits and then eight 1 bits. Done is yes on the last delimiter bit and no on other ticks. Say 1 while idle. Error events do not overlap in these tests.
en.用寄存卡记住标志进行到哪一拍：发现错误时存入起点，下一拍才开始说显性。: Use a register for the flag position: store the beginning when an error is detected; dominant bits start on the next tick.
en.前六拍说 0，接下来的八拍说 1；走完以后保持空闲。: Say 0 for the first six ticks and 1 for the next eight; remain idle afterwards.
en.六个连续显性位破坏正常帧的填充约定，让其他节点也能发现错误；界定之后还需要帧间隔: Six consecutive dominant bits violate normal frame stuffing so other nodes can detect the error. Intermission is still needed after the delimiter.
en.错误后从下一拍驱动六位显性，再保持八位隐性界定；完成在最后一个界定位为是。: Starts a six-bit dominant active error flag on the tick after Error, followed by eight recessive delimiter bits. Done is yes on the last delimiter bit.
en.把发送位错误检测接到主动错误标志。发现错误的那一拍已经说出去了；节点从下一拍开始: Connect transmitted-bit error detection to an active error flag. The current bit has already been sent when the error is detected; interrupt the original frame and send the flag from the next tick.
en.按待发送位驱动总线。仲裁段和应答位之外一旦读回不符，记下错误并从下一拍起发送六位: Drive the intended bits. Outside arbitration and ACK, retain a readback error and from the next tick send six dominant error-flag bits and eight recessive delimiter bits, then remain idle. This level models one error-active node and no retry.
en.先排除仲裁和应答；错误检测的同拍结果交给主动错误标志。: As before, exclude arbitration and ACK; give the same-tick detection to the active error flag.
en.用寄存卡记住已经中断原帧；说话口在下一拍切换到错误标志。: Use a register to remember that the original frame was interrupted; switch the sending port to the flag on the next tick.
en.主动错误标志让其他节点也能检测到当前帧已经出错；完整恢复还需要错误计数和重发。: An active error flag lets other nodes detect that the current frame failed. Full recovery also needs error counters and retransmission.
en.控制器分别记发送错误计数 TEC 和接收错误计数 REC。常见发送错误加 8，接: A controller keeps separate transmit and receive error counters, TEC and REC. A common transmit error adds 8 and a receive error adds 1; success reduces the corresponding counter. At thresholds the node must reduce its influence on the bus.
en.这里的事件是受控子集：0 无事、1 一般发送错误、2 发送成功、3 接收错误、4: These events are a controlled subset: 0 none, 1 ordinary transmit error, 2 successful transmission, 3 receive error, 4 successful reception, 5 missing ACK with no dominant bit during the passive error flag. Event 5 does not increase TEC in the passive state; for successful reception with REC over 127, this exercise chooses the permitted value 127.
en.按事件逐拍更新 TEC 与 REC：计数不低于 0；一般发送错误加 8、发送成功: Update TEC and REC on each event without going below zero: ordinary transmit errors add 8 and transmit success subtracts 1; receive errors add 1 and receive success subtracts 1, or sets REC to 127 when it exceeds 127. Give the updated counters and state: 0 active, 1 passive, 2 bus-off. Start clears state first.
en.TEC 或 REC 到 128 进入被动；TEC 到 256 进入下线。: TEC or REC reaching 128 enters passive; TEC reaching 256 enters bus-off.
en.区分一般发送错误与事件 5；被动状态下事件 5 不加 TEC。: Distinguish ordinary transmit errors from event 5, which does not add TEC while passive.
en.下线后保持下线，忽略后续事件，直到练习的开始信号重新初始化。: Once bus-off, retain it and ignore events until the exercise Start signal reinitialises the node.
en.这些事件展示主要计数关系及一种缺应答例外；真实标准还列出其他错误标志、接收和恢复: These events illustrate the main counting relationships and a missing-ACK exception; the full standard also specifies other error-flag, reception and recovery cases.
en.按本练习的事件子集更新 TEC 和 REC，输出 0 主动、1 被动、2 下线；: Updates TEC and REC for this exercise’s event subset; gives 0 active, 1 passive, 2 bus-off. Bus-off is latched until Start reinitialises it.
en.一旦 TEC 或 REC 到 128，节点进入被动错误状态。被动节点发现错误时说: When TEC or REC reaches 128, the node becomes error passive. A passive node sends six recessive error-flag bits instead of pulling the bus low; at TEC 256 it goes bus-off and sends nothing.
en.先用错误计数得到状态；下线时不要启动错误标志，被动时保留标志时长但不驱动显性。: Get the state from the error counters; do not start an error flag while bus-off, and retain the flag duration without driving dominant when passive.
en.状态限制的是节点对总线的影响：被动节点不再用显性错误标志打断其他节点，下线节点不: State limits the node’s effect on the bus: a passive node no longer interrupts others with a dominant error flag, while a bus-off node does not send.
en.发送方在应答位说 1，并读取实际总线。若这一拍仍是 1，就没有节点应答；这不是仲: The sender says 1 in the ACK slot and reads the actual bus. If it is still 1, no node acknowledged. This is an ACK error, not arbitration loss.
en.发送一帧，在应答位交出是否缺应答，其余拍交出「—」。测试包括有应答和无应答；本关: Send a frame and give whether acknowledgement is missing on its ACK slot, or 「—」 on other ticks. Tests include both acknowledged and unacknowledged frames; this level detects the error without interrupting or retrying.
en.发送器标出应答位；在那一拍比较总线与隐性 1。: The transmitter marks the ACK slot; compare the bus with recessive 1 on that tick.
en.缺应答要单独判断：应答位的显性是正常回答，隐性则表示没有接收到应答。: Missing ACK needs its own check: dominant in the ACK slot is a normal response, whereas recessive means no acknowledgement was received.
en.如果应答位一直是隐性，发送方报告错误，等错误界定段和帧间隔结束后重新发送同一帧。: If the ACK slot stays recessive, the sender reports an error and retries the same frame after the error delimiter and intermission. This exercise covers a small number of missing ACKs while error-active.
en.组合发送器、错误标志和错误计数器；错误标志后数连续的隐性位。重发需要重新取出原来: Combine the transmitter, error flag, and fault counter; count consecutive recessive bits after the flag. Retrying requires reading the original bytes again.
en.缺应答会使错误主动的发送方增加发送错误计数，并中断当前帧。错误处理之后，发送方重: A missing ACK increases an error-active sender’s transmit error count and interrupts the current frame. After error handling the sender retries the original frame. The error-passive exception is outside this exercise.
en.错误被动节点发送完一帧或错误帧后，帧间隔结束还要多等八位，才可以再次主动发送。主: After an error-passive node transmits a frame or error frame, it must wait another eight bits after intermission before initiating another transmission. An error-active node needs no extra wait; a bus-off node cannot transmit.
en.「间隔结束」为 1 时记住状态并重新开始等待。状态 0 表示主动、1 表示被动、: When Intermission end is 1, remember the state and restart the wait. State 0 is active, 1 is passive, and 2 is bus-off. The bus remains idle: active nodes can send from the next tick; passive nodes wait the following eight ticks and can send from the ninth. Bus-off nodes cannot send. Another intermission end restarts the wait.
en.记住是否已经遇到间隔结束，以及当时的状态。计数器在每次间隔结束时重来。: Remember whether intermission has ended and the state at that moment. Restart the counter on every intermission end.
en.被动节点的额外八位称为发送暂停。这里总线保持空闲；若别的节点先开口，真实节点会先: The passive node’s extra eight bits are called suspend transmission. Here the bus stays idle; if another node starts first, a real node receives that frame.
en.记住帧间隔结束时的状态；空闲总线上，被动发送方额外等待八拍，主动发送方无需额外等: Remembers the state at intermission end. On an idle bus, passive senders wait eight extra ticks, active senders need no extra wait, and bus-off nodes cannot transmit.
en.发送请求可能在节点尚未等完时到达。把刚搭出的发送暂停元件接到请求上，让节点只在允: A transmit request may arrive before the node has waited long enough. Connect your suspend-transmission component to the request so the node starts only when allowed.
en.在空闲总线上，只有收到发送请求并且发送暂停已经结束，才回答「是」。状态在每次间隔: On an idle bus, answer yes only when a transmission is requested and suspend transmission has ended. Sample state at each intermission end.
en.用发送暂停元件判断是否已等够，再与发送请求组合。: Use the suspend-transmission component to determine when the wait is over, and combine it with the transmit request.
en.等待和请求是两个条件：被动节点不能因为有请求而跳过额外的八位。: Waiting and a request are separate conditions: a passive node cannot skip its extra eight bits just because a request is pending.
en.跨过门槛的那一次: The error that crosses the threshold
en.计数达到 128 时节点变为被动。导致这次转换的错误仍由此前的主动节点报告，所以: A node becomes error-passive when a counter reaches 128. The error causing this transition is still reported by the previously active node, so it sends an active error flag; subsequent errors use passive flags.
en.逐拍更新错误计数和状态。报告与错误事件同时出现，从下一拍开始发送对应标志和界定段: Update the error counts and state each tick. Report arrives with an error event; from the next tick send the corresponding flag and delimiter. The error that changes active to passive still sends six dominant bits. Tests have no overlapping flags and report occurs only with an error event; bus-off nodes do not send.
en.记住错误发生前的状态，并在报告时锁存标志类型。状态转为被动不能改变正在发送的主动: Remember the state before the error and latch the flag type on Report. Entering passive state must not change an active flag already being sent.
en.进入被动状态的那一次错误发主动标志；之后检测到的错误才按被动状态报告。: The error that enters passive state produces an active flag; later errors are reported according to the passive state.
en.按事件更新状态。收到「报告」时，从下一拍开始发送对应的错误标志和八位隐性界定：主: Update the state from the events. On Report, send the corresponding error flag and eight-bit recessive delimiter starting on the next tick: active says six 0s, passive says six 1s, and bus-off does not transmit. Output the state and completion signal. Flags do not overlap in the tests; the state does not change at Report or during a flag.
en.如果被动发送方收不到应答，而且被动错误标志期间没有检测到显性，它的发送错误计数不: When a passive sender misses an ACK and detects no dominant bit during its passive error flag, that error does not increase its transmit error count. It still retries, waiting another eight bits after intermission.
en.准备阶段给 16 次一般发送错误，使计数达到 128；这是直接提供事件的练习，不: The preparation stage gives 16 ordinary transmit errors to reach a count of 128; this exercise supplies events directly instead of simulating those 16 frames.
en.错误标志结束后再等三个帧间隔位，把间隔结束接到发送暂停元件；被动标志期间总线保持: After the error flag finishes, wait three intermission bits and connect intermission end to the suspend-transmission component. The bus remains recessive throughout the passive flag.
en.缺应答不会单独让满足该例外的被动节点下线。帧成功后计数下降；真实总线上还要处理其: Missing ACK alone does not force a passive node satisfying this exception bus-off. Its count decreases after a successful frame. A real bus must also handle other nodes starting during the wait or driving dominant during the error flag.
en.发送一帧标准格式数据帧，并标出仲裁段、应答位与帧结束末位。标识符与长度需保持到发: Sends one standard-format data frame and marks arbitration, ACK and the last end-of-frame bit. Keep identifier and length stable until Done and supply data from the queue. Outputs driven bits, byte acceptance and completion; arbitration loss and retry are not yet handled.
en.「开始」时发送一帧标准格式数据帧。按协议驱动总线，标出仲裁段、应答位和帧结束末位: On Start, send one standard-format data frame. Drive the bus and mark arbitration, ACK and the last end-of-frame bit; take each queued byte when its last original bit is accepted, and give yes on Done on the final intermission bit. Say 1 while idle.
en.发送一帧；缺应答时发六位显性错误标志，重置队列，等待八位错误界定段及三位帧间隔后: Send a frame. On a missing ACK, send a six-bit dominant error flag, rewind the queue, and retry after the eight-bit error delimiter and three-bit intermission. Output each attempt, completion, and the transmit error count. After successful transmission through the final end-of-frame bit, decrease the count by one to a minimum of zero.
en.先按「准备事件」更新错误计数，再发送一帧。总线上没有其他故障：缺应答时输出被动错: First update the error count from Preparation events, then send a frame. No other errors occur on the bus: on a missing ACK, send a passive error flag, reread the queue, and retry after the error delimiter, intermission and suspend transmission. Output every start, byte taken, queue rewind, completion, count and state; record a successful transmission on the final end-of-frame bit.
en.发送错误计数达到 256 时，节点下线，不能影响总线。要允许恢复，它必须先观察到: When the transmit error count reaches 256, the node goes bus-off and cannot affect the bus. Before it may recover, it must observe 128 groups of eleven consecutive recessive bits; groups may be separated by dominant bits.
en.下线时逐拍观察输入位。每数到十一位连续的 1，完整组数加一并从零继续；显性 0: While bus-off, observe each input bit. For every eleven consecutive 1s increment the completed group count and restart the run; a dominant 0 clears an incomplete run but preserves completed groups. At 128, retain the count and answer yes. Clear all progress when Bus-off is 0.
en.一张寄存卡数当前连续的隐性位，另一张记完整组数。每完成一组，第一张从零重新数。: Use one register to count the current recessive run and another for completed groups. Restart the first after every completed group.
en.满足观察条件后节点才可以恢复；具体控制器还可能要求软件请求。恢复时错误计数清零。: The node may recover only after observing the required groups; a particular controller may also require a software request. Recovery resets its error counters.
en.下线时观察 128 组互不重叠的十一位隐性；显性清除未完成的一组，下线输入为 0: While bus-off, observes 128 non-overlapping groups of eleven recessive bits; a dominant bit clears the incomplete group and Bus-off 0 clears all progress.
en.观察条件满足后，控制器还可能需要软件明确请求恢复。本练习把请求与已完成的观察条件: After the observation condition is met, a controller may also need an explicit software recovery request. This exercise combines the request with the completed observation.
en.只在下线期间已经观察到 128 组十一位隐性，且本拍收到恢复请求时，交出「是」；: Answer yes only on a recovery request when 128 groups of eleven recessive bits have been observed while bus-off; otherwise answer no. Progress clears when Bus-off is 0.
en.使用下线恢复观察元件，把它的允许恢复与请求组合。: Use the bus-off recovery observation component and combine its permission with the request.
en.允许复位后，还要重置错误计数，并回到主动状态；本关只判断请求是否被允许。: Once reset is allowed, error counts must also be reset and the node returned to the active state. This exercise only decides whether the request is permitted.
en.恢复条件和请求都满足后，节点才能重置两个错误计数并回到主动状态。为了让每拍的先后: Once both the observation condition and the request are satisfied, the node may reset its error counters and return to the active state. To make tick order explicit, this exercise resets on the tick after accepting the request.
en.按事件更新发送计数、接收计数和状态。下线后从下一拍开始观察输入位；累计 128: Update transmit count, receive count and state from events. Starting on the tick after bus-off, observe the input bit. After 128 groups of eleven recessive bits, accept a recovery request and reset both counters and return active on the next tick. Initialize starts the exercise.
en.把上一拍的状态接给下线恢复观察元件；请求获准后用寄存卡保存，下一拍复位错误计数元: Connect the previous tick’s state to the bus-off recovery observer. Store an accepted request in a register and reset the fault counter on the next tick.
en.下线时仍可监听总线，但不能影响总线。恢复条件、软件请求和计数清零需要按顺序连接。: A bus-off node can still listen but cannot affect the bus. Connect the recovery condition, software request and counter reset in order.
en.输了再发，没应答再发: Retry after arbitration and missing ACK
en.控制器可能先在仲裁中落败，听完并应答赢家，再发送自己的帧；重发时也可能等不到应答: A controller may first lose arbitration, receive and acknowledge the winner, and then send its own frame; that retry may also go unacknowledged. Now connect these two different waits.
en.从开始拍发送数据帧。仲裁落败时停止发送、接收并应答正确的赢家帧，在帧间隔后重试；: Send a data frame on Start. If arbitration is lost, stop sending, receive and acknowledge a correct winning frame, and retry after intermission. If your frame is not acknowledged, send an active error flag, rewind the queue and retry after the error delimiter and intermission. Give loss, each attempt, queue advances and rewind, completion and the transmit error count. Tests have at most one initial contention, distinct identifiers, a correct winning frame and a small number of missing ACKs.
en.复用仲裁器和校验抓帧器。赢家 CRC 正确时记下应答，下一拍拉低总线。: Reuse the arbiter and checked frame capture. When the winner’s CRC is correct, remember to acknowledge and pull the bus dominant on the next tick.
en.用不同状态区分接收赢家与发送错误标志；两种情况都等总线连续 11 位隐性后重新发: Use separate states for receiving the winner and sending an error flag. In either case, retry after eleven consecutive recessive bus bits. Only missing ACK rewinds the already consumed queue.
en.仲裁落败不是错误：它不增加发送错误计数。缺应答会中断当前帧并记账，队列必须从头重: Losing arbitration is not an error and does not increase the transmit error count. Missing ACK interrupts the frame and updates the count, and the queue must be read again. This exercise does not yet cover bit errors, passive nodes or another frame arriving during the wait.
en.发送过程中，除了缺应答，发送方也可能在仲裁段以外发现自己说的位和总线实际位不同。: Besides a missing ACK, a sender may find outside arbitration that the bit it said differs from the actual bus. A bit error also interrupts the frame, and bytes already taken must be sent again.
en.连接仲裁、接收应答、位错误与缺应答恢复。仲裁段的显性覆盖是正常落败，应答位的显性: Connect arbitration, receiving and acknowledging, bit errors and missing-ACK recovery. Dominant overriding recessive during arbitration is normal loss, and dominant in the ACK slot is a normal acknowledgement. A mismatch on another transmitted bit, or a recessive ACK slot, reports an error, sends an active error flag and retries the entire frame. Tests have one initial contention at most, at most one flipped bit, a small number of missing ACKs and an error-active sender.
en.先排除仲裁段和应答位，再比较发送位与采样位；只在自己仍在发送时检查。: Exclude arbitration and ACK before comparing the transmitted bit with the sampled bit; check only while your node is transmitting.
en.两种发送错误都重置队列和等待状态。错误计数区分一般发送错误与缺应答事件。: Both transmit errors rewind the queue and restart the wait. The fault counter distinguishes ordinary transmit errors from missing ACK events.
en.数据中途出错时，队列可能已经取走了部分字节；重发要从第一个字节开始。这里还没有合: A fault midway through data can occur after part of the queue has been consumed; retry must start from the first byte. This exercise does not yet combine passive state, bus-off or receive errors.
en.两个发送方使用同一个标识符时，仲裁字段完全相同，谁也不会退出。如果后面的数据不同: When two transmitters use the same identifier, their arbitration fields match and neither withdraws. If their data differs, dominant overrides recessive and a transmitter can detect a bit error in the data field.
en.两个节点同时发送相同标识符、长度相同但内容不同的数据帧。检查仲裁段和应答位以外的: Two nodes simultaneously send data frames with the same identifier and length but different payloads. Check transmitted bits outside arbitration and the ACK slot: if what you say differs from what you hear, send an active error flag and eight-bit delimiter starting next tick. Output error state and completion; the other sender also detects bit errors on the actual bus and sends a flag.
en.复用位错误检测与错误标志。仲裁不能按数据字段决定赢家；看到不同的数据要按发送错误: Reuse bit-error detection and the error flag. Arbitration cannot choose a winner from the data field; treat differing data as a transmit error.
en.同一个标识符不能靠仲裁区分两个不同的数据源。先发现位错误的一方开始发送错误标志，: Arbitration cannot distinguish different data sources with the same identifier. The first sender to detect a bit error starts an error flag; the other may detect one later, and their flags overlap on the bus. This exercise does not simulate retry.
en.把发送错误的处理接到错误状态上：主动节点用显性错误标志，被动节点用隐性标志，并在: Connect transmit-error handling to fault state: active nodes send dominant error flags, while passive nodes send recessive flags and wait eight additional bits after intermission. The error that makes a node passive still sends an active flag.
en.先按准备事件更新发送计数，再发送数据帧。处理初次仲裁、位错误和缺应答；按错误发生: First update the transmit count from preparation events, then send a data frame. Handle initial arbitration, bit errors and missing ACK. Choose the flag from the state before the error and decide the extra eight-bit wait from the state after error handling. A missing ACK does not increase the count when a passive flag sees no dominant bit. Output each attempt, queue operations, transmit error, count and state. Tests do not enter bus-off or add another frame during the wait.
en.用寄存卡保存错误发生前的状态，确保跨过 128 的那一次仍发主动标志。: Use a register to remember the state before the error, so the error that crosses 128 still sends an active flag.
en.错误标志完成后数三个帧间隔位，再把错误处理后的状态接到发送暂停元件；每次错误都要: After the error flag finishes, count three intermission bits and connect the resulting state to suspend transmission; restart the wait for every error.
en.错误发生前后的状态各有作用：前者决定本次错误标志，后者决定重发前是否需要发送暂停: The state before an error determines its flag; the state after it determines whether the next attempt needs suspend transmission. After ACK and the end-of-frame field, decrement the transmit count.
en.下线之后，再回总线: Return to the bus after bus-off
en.错误计数继续上升到 256 时，节点下线，不再驱动总线。它必须观察完 128 组: When the transmit error count reaches 256, the node goes bus-off and no longer drives the bus. It must observe 128 groups of eleven recessive bits and receive a recovery request before clearing its counters and retrying the pending frame.
en.先按准备事件更新计数，再发送一帧。处理主动与被动发送错误；若节点下线，停止驱动并: First update the count from preparation events, then send a frame. Handle active and passive transmit errors; if the node goes bus-off, release and observe the bus, accepting a request only after the recovery condition is met. On the next tick clear the count and retry the original frame. During bus-off the tests keep the bus recessive and do not simulate other nodes’ frames.
en.用上一拍状态判断是否下线，将总线和下线状态接入下线恢复观察元件。: Use the previous tick’s state to determine bus-off and connect the bus and that state to the bus-off recovery observer.
en.把观察完成与恢复请求组合后存入寄存卡；下一拍同时复位错误计数和重新开始发送。: Store the combination of completed observation and recovery request in a register. On the next tick both reset the fault counter and restart transmission.
en.下线节点不能继续尝试发送。完整的观察条件和恢复请求都满足后，才清零计数并让等待中: A bus-off node cannot keep transmitting. Only once both the observation condition and the recovery request are satisfied does it clear the count and retry the pending frame.
en.在连续总线上读帧的标识符、长度和数据字节；结果就绪时输出 0 正确、1 填充错误: Reads each frame’s identifier, length and data bytes on a continuous bus; when a result is ready, outputs 0 for valid, 1 for a stuff error or 2 for a CRC error, along with whether the frame matches. Errors here do not change the length field.
en.持续读取总线，交出每帧的标识符、长度和数据字节。发现填充错误时立即交出「否」和种: Read the continuous bus and give each frame’s identifier, length and data bytes. On a stuffing error immediately give no and kind 1; otherwise give the CRC result on the CRC delimiter, with kind 0 for valid or 2 for a CRC error. Give 「—」 on other ticks for each output.
en.收到完整帧后，正确的接收方在应答位拉低总线。填充错误要在下一拍报告；CRC 错误: After receiving a valid frame, a receiver pulls the ACK slot dominant. A stuff error is reported on the next tick; a CRC error waits until after the ACK delimiter before sending an error flag.
en.校验抓帧器交出结果种类：0 正确、1 填充错误、2 CRC 错误。用寄存卡把正确: The checked frame capture gives result kind: 0 valid, 1 stuff error, 2 CRC error. Delay a valid result by one tick with a register to drive the ACK slot.
en.填充错误立即触发错误标志；CRC 错误先延迟两拍，再触发标志。接收成功在应答拍记: Trigger an error flag immediately for a stuff error; delay a CRC error by two ticks before triggering the flag. Record successful reception on the ACK tick.
en.填充错误立即报告，CRC 错误等待应答界定位结束；正确接收时应答并降低接收错误计: A stuff error is reported immediately; a CRC error waits until the ACK delimiter ends. A correct reception is acknowledged and reduces the receive error count. Overlapping error flags and passive receivers are outside this exercise.
en.把接收与应答封装起来后，可以让另一块板只在检测到接收错误的那一拍发出提醒。: Once receive and acknowledge is packed as a component, another board can signal precisely the tick on which a receive error is detected.
en.在结果就绪时检查种类是否为 1 或 2；正确的种类 0 不应触发提醒。: When a result is ready, check whether its kind is 1 or 2; valid kind 0 must not trigger the signal.
en.结果种类让后续电路区分正确帧、填充错误和 CRC 错误；应答和错误标志仍由接收元: The result kind lets later circuits distinguish a correct frame, a stuff error and a CRC error; the receive component still sends ACK and error flags on time.
en.使用接收与应答元件驱动总线并维护接收计数，同时交出计数事件；填充错误或 CRC: Use the receive-and-acknowledge component to drive the bus, maintain the receive count and output the counter event; give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error is detected and no on other ticks.
en.接收方处于被动错误状态时，仍要应答正确的帧；发现错误时发送隐性错误标志。使节点从: A receiver in error-passive state still acknowledges a correct frame, but sends a recessive error flag when it detects an error. The error that changes a node from active to passive still uses an active flag.
en.记住错误发生时的状态，用它控制整个错误标志；应答拍要单独保留，不能把被动错误标志: Remember the state when the error is detected and use it for the whole flag. Preserve ACK separately: the rule for a passive error flag does not apply to acknowledgements.
en.被动接收方仍可应答正确帧，只是错误标志不再拉低总线。标志类型由发现错误时的状态决: A passive receiver still acknowledges correct frames; only its error flag no longer pulls the bus dominant. The state when the error is detected determines the flag type.
en.现在把接收结果和错误状态结合起来，交出错误发生的那一拍，同时保留节点的应答与标志: Now combine receive results and error state to signal the tick an error occurs while retaining the node’s ACK and flag timing.
en.使用状态化接收元件；填充错误或 CRC 错误出现的那一拍交出「是」，其余拍交出「: Use the state-aware receiver; give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error appears and no otherwise. Also drive the bus and output the counter event.
en.结果就绪时，种类 1 或 2 表示接收错误；状态化接收元件负责选择标志并保留正确: When a result is ready, kind 1 or 2 means a receive error; the state-aware receiver chooses the flag and retains valid ACKs.
en.接收错误事件可以送到统一的错误计数器；错误标志与应答的时序仍由接收电路负责。: Receive error events can feed a shared fault counter; the receive circuit remains responsible for the timing of ACK and error flags.
en.节点的主动或被动状态同时取决于发送和接收错误计数。现在把接收电路的计数事件交给统: A node’s active or passive state depends on both transmit and receive error counts. Connect receive counter events to the shared fault counter, then use the resulting state to select receive error flags.
en.把接收电路的计数事件接到错误计数元件，用寄存卡保存上一拍状态，再送回状态化接收元: Connect the receive circuit’s counter event to the fault counter; save the previous tick’s state in a register and feed it to the state-aware receiver.
en.发送计数或接收计数达到 128 都会使节点进入被动状态；导致转换的接收错误仍发主: Either transmit or receive count reaching 128 makes a node passive; the receive error causing that transition still sends an active flag.
en.把接收与统一计数封装后，另一块板可以观察接收错误，同时保留当前状态和总线行为。: Once reception and the shared counter are packed together, another board can observe receive errors while retaining the state and bus behavior.
en.使用统一状态接收元件；交出状态和计数事件，在填充或 CRC 错误出现的那一拍交出: Use the shared-state receiver; give the state and counter event, and give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error appears and no otherwise. Drive the bus according to the component’s acknowledgement and error flag.
en.结果就绪时，种类 1 或 2 是错误；状态和总线驱动直接取自统一状态接收元件。: When a result is ready, kind 1 or 2 is an error; take state and bus drive from the shared-state receiver.
en.统一计数状态可供收发两侧共用；本练习仍只接入了接收侧。: The shared counter state can serve both transmission and reception; this exercise connects reception only.
en.现在把同一节点的接收和发送接在一起。接收帧改变的错误状态必须保留下来，影响随后的: Connect reception and transmission on the same node. The fault state changed by a received frame must carry over to later transmission; while sending, the node must not acknowledge its own frame as if it came from another sender.
en.先接收一帧并按状态应答或报告接收错误；随后在开始拍发送队列中的一帧，处理位错误和: First receive a frame and acknowledge it or report its receive error according to state; then send the queued frame on Start, handling bit errors and missing-ACK retries. Sending and receiving share one fault counter and state; while transmitting, do not feed your own bits to the receiver. Tests are receive-then-send, without simultaneous arbitration, new frames during waits or bus-off.
en.把接收电路的计数事件和发送事件接到同一个错误计数器；发送事件发生时优先处理发送事: Connect receive counter events and transmit events to the same fault counter, giving transmit events priority when they occur.
en.开始发送的当拍就屏蔽接收输入，直到自己的帧和间隔完成；空闲时让接收电路驱动应答及: Mask the receiver input on the tick transmission starts and until the node’s frame and intermission finish; while idle, let the receive circuit drive ACK and error flags.
en.接收错误可能让节点进入被动状态，改变下一次发送的错误标志和等待。屏蔽自发帧避免节: A receive error can make the node passive, changing the flag and delay on its next transmission. Masking the node’s own frame prevents it acknowledging itself. This exercise does not yet cover simultaneous receive/transmit contention or another frame arriving while waiting.
en.发送时可能有另一个节点同时开口。接收器必须从帧起始就跟踪总线：一旦自己仲裁落败，: Another node may start at the same time as your transmission. The receiver must follow the bus from start of frame so that, if your node loses arbitration, it can continue receiving and acknowledge the winner.
en.先接收一帧，再与另一个节点同时尝试发送。若落败，接收并应答赢家、更新接收计数，帧: First receive one frame, then attempt transmission simultaneously with another node. If you lose, receive and acknowledge the winner, update the receive count and retry after intermission; if you win, do not acknowledge your own frame. Continue handling bit errors and missing ACKs with shared counts. Tests have one initial contention, distinct identifiers, a correct winner, no new frame while waiting and no bus-off.
en.接收器持续跟踪总线；只有空闲接收或仲裁落败时才转交它的事件与驱动。: Keep the receiver following the bus; forward its events and drive only when receiving while idle or after arbitration loss.
en.重发开始的当拍先选择自己的发送位，即使上一拍仍在接收赢家；正确接收赢家时，接收计: On the tick retry starts, choose your own transmitted bit even if you were still receiving the winner on the previous tick. A valid winning frame updates the receive count in its ACK slot.
en.提前跟踪帧起始使落败节点能够完整接收赢家。若自己获胜，同一接收器的结果必须被屏蔽: Following the start of frame lets a losing node receive the complete winner. If the node wins, the same receiver’s results must be suppressed to prevent self-ACK and incorrect accounting.
en.等待时有人开口: Another node starts during the wait
en.被动节点刚发送过帧，正在多等八位时，另一个节点可能先开始发送。它要转为接收方，收: A passive node may be in its extra eight-bit wait when another node starts transmitting. It must become a receiver, receive and acknowledge that frame, then wait for its intermission to finish.
en.复用发送暂停和状态化接收元件；检测连续隐性后的显性帧起始，记住需要先接收。: Reuse suspend transmission and the state-aware receiver; detect a dominant start after consecutive recessive bits and remember that a frame must be received first.
en.收到新帧时，等待应答后的十一位隐性（应答界定位、帧结束和帧间隔），再交出一次重试: When a new frame arrives, wait for eleven recessive bits following its ACK: ACK delimiter, end of frame and intermission. Then issue one retry.
en.发送暂停期间若另一节点开口，被动节点先转为接收。接收完成后按新帧的间隔重新获得发: If another node starts during suspend transmission, the passive node first becomes a receiver. After the frame and its intermission it has another opportunity to send.
en.接收后发回自己的帧: Send the pending frame after reception
en.接收并应答插入的帧后，把保存的数据重新交给发送器；如果没有人插入，就在暂停结束后: After receiving and acknowledging the intervening frame, give the retained data back to the transmitter. If no frame intervenes, transmit after suspension.
en.将暂停中接收元件接到发送器。重试拍开始发送队列中的整帧；发送前由接收元件驱动总线: Connect receive-during-suspension to the transmitter. Start sending the whole queued frame on Retry; before sending, let the receiver drive the bus, and during sending let the transmitter drive it. Give Retry, byte acceptance and completion. Pending frames are acknowledged in the tests.
en.重试拍直接启动发送器并选择它的驱动；用寄存卡保持发送状态，直到自己的帧间隔结束。: Use Retry to start the transmitter and select its drive on that tick; hold transmission state in a register until your own frame’s intermission ends.
en.暂停被新帧打断不会丢掉待发数据：先应答新帧，再从队首发送自己的完整帧。: An intervening frame does not discard pending data: first acknowledge the new frame, then send your own complete frame from the front of the queue.
en.重发等待中收到新帧: Receive a new frame while waiting to retry
en.缺应答后，节点可能进入被动状态。等待重发的额外八位期间，如果别的节点先发送，就要: After a missing ACK, a node may be passive. If another node starts during the extra eight-bit wait before retrying, first receive and acknowledge its frame, then continue the original retry.
en.先接收一帧，再发送自己的队列帧；第一次发送缺应答。错误处理后若处于被动状态，暂停: First receive a frame, then send your queued frame; its first attempt is not acknowledged. If error handling leaves the node passive, a frame may start during suspension: receive and acknowledge it, update the shared receive count, and retry the original frame after its intermission. Without an intervening frame, retry after normal suspend transmission. Tests use a correct intervening frame, no simultaneous arbitration and no bus-off.
en.在错误标志和界定完成、帧间隔结束时启动暂停中接收元件；只有错误处理后的被动状态使: Start the receive-during-suspension component after the error flag, delimiter and intermission; use it only when the state after error handling is passive.
en.暂停中接收的驱动、结果和计数事件都要接入主电路；重发开始拍优先选择自己的发送器。: Connect the suspension receiver’s drive, result and counter event to the main circuit; prioritize your own transmitter on the retry start tick.
en.等待期间接收的帧也影响统一接收计数；原来的发送队列仍从头重读。导致进入被动的错误: A frame received during the wait also affects the shared receive count; the original transmit queue is still read again from its beginning. The error causing entry to passive still sends an active flag before reception during suspension.
en.把已经搭出的收发、仲裁、错误处理和下线恢复接到同一节点：既能接收并应答，也能保留: Connect the reception, transmission, arbitration, error handling and bus-off recovery you built into one node. It can receive and acknowledge, retain a pending frame, and retry after errors or contention.
en.统一错误计数器接收发送与接收事件；接收器持续跟踪总线，自己的帧不能触发自应答。: Feed receive and transmit events to the shared fault counter. The receiver follows the bus continuously, but the node must not acknowledge itself.
en.被动暂停交给暂停中接收元件；下线观察与请求获准后，用寄存卡在下一拍复位计数并重启: Use receive-during-suspension for passive waits. Once bus-off observation and a request are satisfied, use a register to reset counts and restart transmission on the next tick.
en.这块控制器原型把所练习的收发、仲裁、错误和恢复路径连起来。它仍限定测试中的帧类型: This controller prototype connects the receive, transmit, arbitration, error and recovery paths exercised here. Its tested frame types and error combinations are limited and it does not yet cover all CAN controller behavior.
en.封装后的控制器同时维护待发队列、收发错误计数和恢复状态。把它接到总线，检查外部电: The packed controller maintains the pending queue, receive and transmit error counts, and recovery state. Connect it to the bus and check that an external board can read these results.
en.把总线、帧字段、队列和控制输入接到控制器，再转交每个对应结果。: Connect the bus, frame fields, queue and control inputs to the controller, then forward each corresponding result.
en.封装件运行的是之前搭出的逐拍电路；高一层可以使用它的结果，但不能把本练习未覆盖的: The packed component runs the tick-by-tick circuit built earlier. Higher layers may use its results, but must not treat untested errors as verified.
en.接收一帧：正确时在应答位说 0；填充错误时从下一拍发主动错误标志，CRC 错误时: Receive one frame: say 0 in the ACK slot if valid; after a stuff error send an active flag from the next tick, and after a CRC error send it following the ACK delimiter. Output result kind, result ready, ACK tick, counter event and receive error count. Preparation events supply receive errors before the frame; decrement the count on successful acknowledgement and increment it on error. Tests contain one frame, one error-active receiver and at most one flipped data or CRC bit. Also give received identifier, length and bytes as they arrive; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.读取总线，正确接收时应答并标出应答拍，填充或 CRC 错误按各自时序发主动标志；: Reads the bus, acknowledges correct frames and marks the ACK tick, and sends active flags at the appropriate time for stuff and CRC errors; outputs counter events and updates the receive error count. Limited to one frame and no overlapping errors. Also outputs received identifier, length and bytes; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.接收并应答正确帧；发现填充或 CRC 错误时，按错误发生前的状态选择主动或被动标: Receive and acknowledge valid frames. On a stuff or CRC error, select an active or passive flag according to the state before the error. State input 0 is active and 1 is passive; it may change after error detection. Output the result, ACK tick, counter event and receive count. Tests do not enter bus-off or simulate overlapping error flags. Also give received identifier, length and bytes as they arrive; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.复用接收与应答元件，按错误发生前的主动或被动状态选择错误标志，同时保留正确帧的显: Reuses receive and acknowledge, choosing error flags from the active or passive state before the error while retaining dominant acknowledgements for valid frames. Also outputs received identifier, length and bytes; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.准备事件可包含发送错误 1 或接收错误 3。接收一帧，交出两个计数、状态、接收结: Preparation events may include transmit error 1 or receive error 3. Receive one frame and output both counts, state, receive result and counter event; acknowledge a valid frame, and choose an error flag from the state before an error. Tests do not enter bus-off and have no overlapping errors. Also give received identifier, length and bytes as they arrive; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.将状态化接收与统一错误计数连接；根据发送和接收计数选择接收错误标志，正确接收时应: Connects state-aware reception to shared error counts; selects receive flags from transmit and receive counts and acknowledges correct frames. Limited to one frame, no bus-off and no overlapping errors. Also outputs received identifier, length and bytes; fields after an error result are not valid data.
en.「间隔结束」后等待被动发送暂停；若等待期间有新帧，从帧起始开始接收，正确时应答，: After Intermission end, wait through passive suspend transmission. If a new frame starts during the wait, receive it from start of frame and acknowledge it if valid, then give 1 on Retry after that frame’s intermission. If no frame starts, retry after the extra eight bits. Output receive counter events; each test waits once and incoming frames are valid. Also output each received identifier, length and byte; treat these fields as a valid frame only after its check succeeds.
en.被动发送暂停期间若新帧开始，接收并应答它，交出接收计数事件，然后在帧间隔后给出一: During passive suspension, receives and acknowledges a newly started frame, outputs its receive counter event and gives one retry after intermission; without a new frame retries after the eight-bit wait. Limited to one valid frame. Also outputs received fields tick by tick; only validated frames may be passed to higher layers.
en.先接收一帧，再发送队列帧。处理一次初始仲裁、发送位错误或缺应答；按共享状态选择标: First receive a frame, then send the queued frame. Handle one initial arbitration, a transmit bit error or missing ACK; select flags and waits from shared state. A correct frame may interrupt passive suspension. After bus-off, observe the required bits and accept a recovery request, then clear counts and retry on the next tick. Tests do not combine arbitration with an intervening frame or simulate overlapping errors or frames during bus-off. Also output each received identifier, length and byte; treat these fields as a valid frame only after its check succeeds.
en.逐拍接收、应答与发送标准格式数据帧，处理限定的一次初始仲裁、发送错误、被动暂停插: Receives, acknowledges and transmits standard data frames tick by tick; handles one initial arbitration, transmit errors, a correct frame interrupting passive suspension, and bus-off recovery with shared counters. Does not cover every error, frame type or timing combination. Also outputs received fields tick by tick; only validated frames may be passed to higher layers.
en.使用 CAN 控制器原型驱动总线，转交队列取走与重置、发送尝试、完成、两个错误计: Use the CAN controller prototype to drive the bus and forward queue advances and rewind, transmission attempts, completion, both error counts, state and recovery permission. Tests cover arbitration, a frame interrupting suspension and bus-off recovery. Also output each received identifier, length and byte; treat these fields as a valid frame only after its check succeeds.
en.一帧里的字节表示什么？: What does a byte in a frame mean?
en.控制器已经能逐位接收。接下来先在干净总线上按帧观察：每拍交来一整帧，争用时标识符: The controller can now receive bit by bit. On a clean bus, observe whole frames: each tick delivers one frame, and the lower identifier wins contention. Errors and retries are not yet simulated here.
en.试车记录中，第一个数据字节为 0、25、60 时，仪表车速分别为 0、50、12: In a road test, first data bytes 0, 25 and 60 correspond to dashboard speeds of 0, 50 and 120 km/h. Find the pattern and make the board give the speed for each frame.
en.同一个字节可以编码一个物理量；这次车速等于字节值的两倍。其他信号的比例和偏移可能: A byte can encode a physical quantity; here the speed is twice its value. Other signals can use different scales and offsets.
en.读取每帧的第一个数据字节，交出对应车速（km/h）。: Read the first data byte of each frame and output the corresponding speed in km/h.
en.比较三组已知数据，试着用算术元件把字节和它自己相加。: Compare the three known examples and try adding the byte to itself with an arithmetic part.
en.一个量可能跨两个字节。试车记录显示 [52, 18] 表示 4660，[1, 2: A value can span two bytes. A road test shows [52, 18] means 4660 and [1, 2] means 513; here the low byte comes first.
en.另一台控制器把高字节放在前面。[18, 52] 表示 4660，[2, 1] 表: Another controller puts the high byte first. [18, 52] means 4660 and [2, 1] means 513. Using low-byte-first order gives the wrong value.
en.按低字节在前的顺序，合成每帧中的双字节信号。: Combine each frame’s two-byte signal with the low byte first.
en.按高字节在前的顺序，合成每帧中的双字节信号。: Combine each frame’s two-byte signal with the high byte first.
en.先确定每个字节的权重，再把它们相加；字节顺序不同，读取方法也不同。: Determine the weight of each byte and add them; changing the byte order changes how the value is read.
en.高字节的权重是 256。可以连续八次把它加倍，再加上低字节。: The high byte has weight 256. Double it eight times, then add the low byte.
en.温度也藏在一个字节里：记录中原始值 20、40、65 对应 −20、0、25 °: Temperature also fits in one byte: raw values 20, 40 and 65 correspond to −20, 0 and 25 °C. Negative temperatures are still encoded by nonnegative bytes.
en.原始值经过比例和偏移才能变成物理量；偏移让非负字节也能表示零下温度。: Scaling and offset convert a raw value into a physical quantity; an offset lets a nonnegative byte encode temperatures below zero.
en.读取第一个字节，交出对应温度（°C）。: Read the first byte and output the corresponding temperature in °C.
en.先找出原始值为 40 时温度为何是零，再用相减元件。: Work out why raw value 40 means zero, then use subtraction.
en.另一种信号直接用八位补码：0 到 127 表示自身，128 到 255 表示减去: Another signal uses eight-bit two’s complement: 0 through 127 represent themselves, while 128 through 255 represent the value minus 256. For example, 255 means −1 and 128 means −128.
en.八位补码的最高位为 1 时，把无符号值减去 256，就得到对应的负数。: When the top bit of an eight-bit two’s-complement value is 1, subtract 256 from the unsigned value to recover the negative number.
en.把每帧的第一个数据字节按八位补码转成有符号整数。: Interpret the first byte of each frame as an eight-bit signed integer.
en.先判断字节是否小于 128，再选择原值或减去 256 的结果。: First check whether the byte is less than 128, then select the original value or the value minus 256.
en.从一个字节里找挡位: Find the gear in a byte
en.一个字节可以同时装几个量。挡位占从最低位数起第 2、3、4 位，共三位；其余位属: One byte can hold several signals. The gear occupies three bits, numbered 2, 3 and 4 from the least significant bit; the other bits belong to other signals.
en.取出每帧第一个字节中的三位挡位，交出 0 到 7。: Extract the three-bit gear from the first data byte of each frame and output 0 through 7.
en.先右移两位，再用二进制 111（十进制 7）按位与，屏蔽周围的位。: Shift right by two bits, then AND with binary 111 (decimal 7) to mask the surrounding bits.
en.右移把字段对齐到最低位，掩码留下需要的位；其他信号的位不会混进挡位。: Shifting aligns the field with the least significant bit; the mask keeps the wanted bits and excludes other signals.
en.数据记录仪接在同一条总线上，会同时收到车速和其他控制器的帧。车速帧的标识符是 0: A data recorder on the shared bus receives speed frames and frames from other controllers. Speed frames have identifier 0x100; the first byte of other frames is not speed.
en.标识符为 0x100 时交出第一个数据字节；其他帧交出「—」。: Output the first data byte when the identifier is 0x100; output 「—」 for other frames.
en.比较标识符是否等于 256；用选择元件在不相符时留下空口。: Compare the identifier with 256; leave the unselected input of a select part open.
en.先按标识符区分帧，再解读其中的字节，才能避免把另一种信号当成车速。: Distinguish frames by identifier before interpreting their bytes, so a different signal is not mistaken for speed.
en.有些帧复用同一位置：第一个字节是选择值，0 表示第二个字节是温度原始值，1 表示: Some frames reuse the same position: the first byte selects the meaning. With 0, the second byte is raw temperature; with 1, it is raw engine speed.
en.选择值为 0 时只交出温度原始值；为 1 时只交出转速原始值。没有对应信号的输出: For selector 0 output only raw temperature; for selector 1 output only raw engine speed. Output 「—」 where that signal is absent.
en.分别比较选择值与 0、1，再用选择元件把数据送到对应输出。: Compare the selector separately with 0 and 1, then use select parts to route the data.
en.先读选择值，再解释复用的数据位置；同一字节不总是同一种信号。: Read the selector before interpreting a multiplexed position; the same byte does not always mean the same signal.
en.记录仪不只看内容，也要知道帧什么时候到。这里时间以位级总线的拍数计，从一帧开始到: A recorder also needs to know when frames arrive. Time here is measured in bit-level bus ticks, from one frame start to the next.
en.每帧交出与上一帧开始时间的差；第一帧没有上一帧，交出「—」。: For each frame output the difference from the previous frame start; output 「—」 for the first frame.
en.用寄存卡保存这帧的开始时间，下一帧用当前时间减去保存的时间。: Save the current start time in a register and subtract the saved time when the next frame arrives.
en.记下上一帧的时间，就能测量到达间隔；同一时刻竞争的帧会先经过仲裁，所以使用实际开: Remembering the previous start time lets you measure arrival intervals. Frames contending at the same time arbitrate first, so use their actual start times.
en.先看一个字节的低两位以外的内容。右移两位会把最低两位移走，其余位向低位移动。: First examine everything except a byte’s two lowest bits. Shifting right by two removes those bits and moves the rest toward the low end.
en.将每帧的第一个数据字节向右移动两位，交出结果。: Shift the first data byte of each frame right by two bits and output the result.
en.把字节接入右移元件，并把移动位数设为 2。: Connect the byte to a shift-right part and set the shift count to 2.
en.右移两位相当于丢掉最低的两位，为提取字段做准备。: Shifting right by two drops the two lowest bits and prepares the value for field extraction.
en.右移让字节中的高位向低位移动。: A right shift moves higher bits toward the low end.
en.用按位与留下需要的位。: Use bitwise AND to keep the bits you need.
en.一些报文带四位滚动计数器：每帧加一，15 之后回到 0。它可以帮助发现漏帧；第一: Some messages carry a four-bit rolling counter: it advances once per frame and wraps from 15 to 0. It can help detect missing frames; on the first frame there is no previous value to compare.
en.第一个数据字节只含 0 到 15 的计数值。第一帧标为有效；之后若比上一帧加一并: The first data byte contains a counter from 0 to 15. Mark the first frame valid; thereafter mark it valid if it advances by one modulo 16, otherwise invalid. Update the previous value on every frame.
en.用寄存卡记住上一值；加一后按位与 15，15 的下一值就会变成 0。用初值 −1: Store the previous value; add one and AND with 15 so the value after 15 becomes 0. Use initial value −1 to recognize the first frame.
en.四位计数器按 16 绕回；15 后面的 0 是正常的，跳过一个值才提示序列不连续: A four-bit counter wraps modulo 16: 0 after 15 is normal, while a skipped value indicates a discontinuity.
en.诊断消息装得下一帧时，可以使用单帧。这里采用标准寻址：第一个字节的低四位给出消息: When a diagnostic message fits in one frame it can use a single frame. With normal addressing, the low four bits of the first byte give the number of message bytes; remaining bytes are padding.
en.每帧都是有效的单帧，读取长度并交出对应的消息字节；不要把填充字节交出去。: Every frame is a valid single frame. Read its length and output the message bytes without padding.
en.用按位与 15 取出低四位，再从数据的第 1 个位置开始按长度截取。位置从 0: AND with 15 to take the low four bits, then slice from data position 1 for that length. Positions start at 0.
en.单帧的长度区分了真正的消息和帧尾填充。更长的消息需要拆分成多帧。: The single-frame length distinguishes message bytes from padding. Longer messages need multiple frames.
en.超过一帧的消息怎样送到？: How can a message longer than a frame arrive?
en.两帧拼回一条消息: Reassemble a message from two frames
en.消息超过七个字节时，首帧给出总长度并携带前六个字节，接着的后续帧以序号 1 开始: When a message exceeds seven bytes, the first frame gives the total length and carries the first six bytes; the following consecutive frame starts with sequence number 1. Here handle only messages of 8 to 13 bytes, requiring exactly one consecutive frame.
en.每帧固定八字节。首帧第一个字节为 0x10，第二个字节是总长度，后六个字节是消息: Every frame has eight bytes. A first frame starts with 0x10, its second byte is the total length, and its last six bytes start the message; a consecutive frame starts with 0x21. After a first frame, output the complete message when the correct consecutive frame arrives, without padding. For a wrong sequence output 「—」 and discard the incomplete message.
en.先保存首帧的六个字节和总长度；后续帧到来时拼接，再从位置 0 截取总长度。用比较: Save the first frame’s six bytes and total length. When the consecutive frame arrives, join its data and slice from position 0 to the total length. Compare the frame headers.
en.首帧携带总长度，后续帧携带序号。接收方要保存片段、检查顺序，再按总长度去掉填充。: The first frame carries the total length and the consecutive frame carries a sequence number. Save the fragments, check their order and trim padding to the total length.
en.消息可能需要多于一个后续帧。后续帧的低四位是序号：从 1 开始，每帧加一，15: A message may need more than one consecutive frame. Its low four header bits are the sequence number: start at 1, increment per frame, and wrap from 15 to 0. For now assume flow control already permits transmission.
en.每帧固定八字节。首帧给出十二位总长度和前六个消息字节；依次接收后续帧，检查四位序: Every frame has eight bytes. The first frame gives a twelve-bit total length and the first six message bytes. Receive consecutive frames in order and check each four-bit sequence number. Once the total length is reached, output the message without padding; discard an incomplete message on a sequence error. When receive is disabled, ignore that frame and retain the incomplete message.
en.寄存已收到的字节、总长度与下一序号。每次拼接后比较已收长度和总长度；序号加一后按: Store the received bytes, total length and next sequence number. After each join compare the received and total lengths; increment the sequence and AND with 15.
en.长消息的重组跨越多帧：保存片段、核对每个序号，收到总长度后才交出消息。流控和超时: Reassembly spans frames: save fragments, check every sequence number, and output only after receiving the total length. Flow control and timeouts still need separate handling.
en.把搭好的重组电路封装起来，再用另一段帧序列检查它。: Package the reassembly circuit and check it with another frame sequence.
en.封装件运行的是你搭建的重组电路，状态属于每一个元件实例。: The packaged part runs the circuit you built, with separate state in each instance.
en.按起点和长度截取消息字节。: Slice message bytes by start and length.
en.按顺序拼接两段字节。: Join two byte sequences in order.
en.通过字节长度判断消息是否收齐。: Use byte length to determine whether the message is complete.
en.使用长消息重组元件，只交出长度大于零的完整消息。: Use the reassembly part and output only complete messages longer than zero bytes.
en.把帧数据接给重组元件，再用字节长度和比较元件检查结果。: Connect the frame data to the reassembly part, then check its result using byte length and comparison.
en.按首帧长度和后续帧序号重组消息；错误序号丢弃未完成消息，当前假定流控已允许且帧数: Reassembles messages by first-frame length and consecutive-frame sequence; discards an incomplete message on a sequence error. Currently assumes flow control permits sending and each frame has eight data bytes. Holds its state when receive is disabled.
en.两个控制器可以交错发送各自的长消息。只有一个重组状态时，第二个首帧会覆盖第一个，: Two controllers can interleave their long messages. With only one reassembly state, the second first frame overwrites the first and the replies get mixed up.
en.标识符 0x7E8 和 0x7E9 的帧可能交错到达。分别重组两边的消息，在各自: Frames from identifiers 0x7E8 and 0x7E9 may arrive interleaved. Reassemble each controller’s message separately and output it when complete; neither may disturb the other.
en.按标识符分别控制两个重组元件的接收允许；每个实例保存自己的状态。: Use the identifier to enable two separate reassembly parts. Each instance keeps its own state.
en.按回答者分开维护重组状态，交错到达的后续帧才会接到正确的消息上。: Keeping separate reassembly state per sender ensures interleaved consecutive frames join the correct message.
en.收到首帧后，接收方可以给发送方一条流控帧。继续发送时，第一个字节为 0x30，后: After a first frame, the receiver can give the sender a flow-control frame. Continue-to-send uses 0x30 as the first byte, followed by block size and minimum separation time. Here prepare the frame data; actual transmission and timing come later.
en.收到首帧时，交出 [0x30, 块大小, 最小间隔]；其他帧交出「—」。块大小和: On a first frame output [0x30, block size, minimum separation]; output 「—」 on other frames. Block size and separation are inputs.
en.把三个单字节序列按顺序拼接；先检查帧头的高四位是否为 1。: Join three single-byte sequences in order; first check whether the high four header bits are 1.
en.流控回答告诉发送方能继续以及后续发送的节奏；准备帧数据只是通信的一部分。: A flow-control reply tells the sender whether to continue and how to pace transmission; preparing its bytes is only part of the exchange.
en.把一个数变成单字节序列，便于组成帧数据。: Turn a number into a single-byte sequence to form frame data.
en.把短消息装进单帧: Pack a short message into one frame
en.发送方向也需要帧数据：长度不超过七字节的非空消息，可以在数据前加一个长度字节。这: For sending, a nonempty message of at most seven bytes can be prefixed by a length byte. Here construct the frame data; actual transmission is not yet simulated.
en.每拍给一条待发送字节序列。长度为 1 到 7 时，在前面加长度字节；空消息或超过: Each tick provides a byte sequence to send. For lengths 1 through 7, prefix the length byte; output 「—」 for an empty or longer message.
en.先测量消息长度并检查范围，再把长度变成单字节序列接到消息前面。: Measure the message and check its length, then turn the length into a byte sequence and join it before the message.
en.单帧发送和接收互为方向相反的操作；更长消息还需要分段与流控。: Single-frame sending reverses reception; longer messages also need segmentation and flow control.
en.诊断工具用服务 0x22 读取数据标识。这个模拟控制器保存标识 0xF190；正: A diagnostic tool uses service 0x22 to read a data identifier. This simulated controller holds identifier 0xF190: the request is [0x22, 0xF1, 0x90], and a positive response starts with [0x62, 0xF1, 0x90].
en.这次先在消息层交互：控制器读取本拍请求，在下一拍回答。这里尚不模拟消息经过 IS: For now this interaction is at the message layer: the controller reads the request on this tick and responds on the next. ISO-TP segmentation, the bus and timeouts are not yet simulated here.
en.每拍发出读取 0xF190 的请求；收到回答后去掉前三个字节，交出数据记录。尚未: On each tick request identifier 0xF190. Once a response arrives, remove the first three bytes and output the data record; before a response arrives output 「—」.
en.先用单字节序列和拼接构造请求，再用字节长度和截取元件从回答位置 3 取出记录。: Construct the request with single-byte sequences and joins; then use byte length and slicing to take the response record from position 3.
en.请求的数据标识决定控制器回答哪条记录；肯定回答保留标识，接收方还要取出后面的数据: The requested identifier determines which record the controller returns. A positive response retains the identifier; the receiver then extracts the record.
en.控制器怎样回答诊断问题？: How do controllers answer diagnostic requests?
en.控制器不支持请求的数据标识时，可以返回否定回答 [0x7F, 原服务号, 原因码: When a controller does not support a requested data identifier, it can return a negative response [0x7F, original service, reason code]. Here 0x31 means the request is out of range.
en.请求数据标识 0xF191。模拟控制器不支持它；从下一拍回答中取出单字节原因码。: Request identifier 0xF191. The simulated controller does not support it; extract the one-byte reason code from the next tick’s response. Output 「—」 before a response arrives.
en.先构造 [0x22, 0xF1, 0x91]，再从回答位置 2 截取一个字节。: Construct [0x22, 0xF1, 0x91], then take one byte at response position 2.
en.否定回答保留被拒绝的服务号，原因码解释为什么没有执行请求。: A negative response retains the rejected service; its reason code explains why the request was not carried out.
en.控制器说请稍等: The controller asks you to wait
en.控制器有时不能立即完成请求，会先返回 [0x7F, 0x22, 0x78] 表示: A controller may not finish a request immediately: it first returns [0x7F, 0x22, 0x78] to say that the response is pending, then sends the final positive response.
en.只在第一拍请求 0xF190。等待期间不要把 0x78 当成数据；收到以 0x6: Request 0xF190 only on the first tick. Do not treat 0x78 as data while waiting; output the record only after a positive response beginning with 0x62 arrives.
en.用寄存卡记住已经请求；比较回答的第一个字节是否为 0x62，再截取记录。: Use a register to remember that the request was sent; check whether the first response byte is 0x62 before extracting the record.
en.等待回答和真正拒绝不同：收到 0x78 后继续等待，直到最终回答到达。这里尚未模: A pending response differs from a final rejection: after 0x78 keep waiting for the final response. Timeouts are not yet modeled here.
en.这个模拟控制器只在扩展会话提供指定记录。进入会话的请求是 [0x10, 0x03: This simulated controller provides the record only in an extended session. Request it with [0x10, 0x03]; a positive response begins [0x50, 0x03]. A direct read in the default session is rejected.
en.第一拍请求扩展会话，第二拍请求数据标识 0xF190；收到以 0x62 开头的回: Request the extended session on the first tick, then request identifier 0xF190 on the second. Output the data record when a response beginning with 0x62 arrives; send no further requests.
en.用寄存卡记录已经过了几拍，分别选择两个请求；只从肯定的数据回答截取记录。: Use a register to track the ticks and select each request; extract the record only from a positive data response.
en.会话会改变控制器允许的操作。这个练习固定下一拍收到会话回答，尚未处理超时或会话失: The session changes which operations the controller permits. This exercise assumes a session response on the next tick; timeouts and session expiry are not yet handled.
en.这个模拟控制器进入扩展会话后，连续三拍没有诊断请求就退回默认会话。测试仪可以发送: This simulated controller returns to its default session after three consecutive ticks without a diagnostic request. The tester can send [0x3E, 0x00] to indicate it is still present and reset the idle timer.
en.第 0 拍进入扩展会话，第 2 和 4 拍发送保持在线，第 6 拍读取 0xF1: Enter the extended session at tick 0, send tester-present messages at ticks 2 and 4, and read 0xF190 at tick 6; send nothing on other ticks. Output the record when the positive data response arrives.
en.用寄存卡数拍，按拍数选择会话、保持在线和读取请求；只提取以 0x62 开头的回答: Count ticks in a register and select the session, tester-present and read requests by tick. Extract a record only from a response beginning with 0x62.
en.周期性保持在线可以避免会话因空闲而退出。这里的三拍是模拟规则，不代表车辆的真实计: Periodic tester-present messages can prevent an idle session from expiring. The three-tick timeout is a simulation rule, not a real vehicle timing.
en.这个模拟控制器还要求安全访问。进入扩展会话后，用 [0x27, 0x01] 请求: This simulated controller also requires security access. After entering the extended session, request a one-byte seed with [0x27, 0x01]. The game’s toy rule XORs the seed with 0x5A to obtain a key.
en.第 0 拍进入扩展会话，第 1 拍请求种子，第 2 拍把计算出的密钥放进 [0x: Enter the extended session at tick 0, request a seed at tick 1, send [0x27, 0x02, key] at tick 2, and read 0xF190 at tick 3. Output the record when the positive response arrives.
en.从种子回答的位置 2 读取种子，与十进制 90 异或，再拼成发送密钥的请求。: Read the seed at position 2 of the seed response, XOR it with decimal 90, and assemble the key request.
en.种子和密钥可以控制受保护服务的访问。本练习的异或算法只是演示，不是实际控制器的安: A seed and key can control access to protected services. This exercise’s XOR rule is only a demonstration, not a real controller security algorithm.
en.从字节序列按位置取出一个字节。: Read one byte at a position in a sequence.
en.在这台模拟控制器上，密钥不对会返回否定回答 [0x7F, 0x27, 0x35]: This simulated controller returns [0x7F, 0x27, 0x35] for an incorrect key. This exercise deliberately sends one wrong key to inspect the reason; repeated failures also cause a temporary lockout.
en.依次进入扩展会话、请求种子，然后发送种子与 0x5B 异或得到的错误密钥。从安全: Enter the extended session, request a seed, then send the wrong key obtained by XORing the seed with 0x5B. Output the reason code from the negative security-access response, and 「—」 at other times.
en.从回答取出服务号和原因码；只有第一个字节是 0x7F 且第二个字节是 0x27: Read the service and reason bytes; output the reason only when the first byte is 0x7F and the second is 0x27.
en.正确识别拒绝原因，才能区分密钥错误和仍在等待；实际安全算法与本游戏的玩具规则不同: Recognizing rejection reasons distinguishes a bad key from a pending response. Real security algorithms differ from the game’s toy rule.
en.模拟控制器支持按状态读取故障码：请求 [0x19, 0x02, 状态掩码]。用: The simulated controller supports reading trouble codes by status with [0x19, 0x02, status mask]. Use 0x08 to select confirmed records. The first three response bytes are service, subfunction and status-availability mask; each following record occupies four bytes.
en.每拍请求已确认的故障码；收到回答后去掉前三字节，交出所有记录字节。没有符合条件的: Request confirmed trouble codes each tick. After a response arrives, remove its first three bytes and output all record bytes. Output an empty sequence if none match.
en.拼出 [0x19, 0x02, 0x08]，再按回答长度从位置 3 截取剩余字节: Assemble [0x19, 0x02, 0x08], then slice the response from position 3 through its remaining length.
en.状态掩码让控制器筛出满足条件的记录；返回的记录数可以为零，也可以多于一条。: The status mask lets the controller select matching records; zero, one or many records can be returned.
en.模拟控制器接受 [0x14, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF] 清除全部故障码: The simulated controller accepts [0x14, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF] to clear all trouble codes. Clearing changes controller state, so a subsequent read should return no records.
en.第 0 拍读取已确认故障码，第 1 拍清除全部故障码，第 2 拍再次读取；只在读: Read confirmed trouble codes at tick 0, clear all trouble codes at tick 1, and read again at tick 2. Output record bytes only when a read response arrives.
en.用寄存卡数拍，交替构造读取与清除请求；检查回答服务号 0x59 后再截取记录。: Count ticks in a register and select read or clear requests; check response service 0x59 before slicing the records.
en.清除是改变状态的操作；再次读取能检查控制器当前是否还保留记录。本练习尚未模拟故障: Clearing changes state; reading again checks which records remain. This exercise does not yet simulate faults returning after a driving cycle.
en.这台虚构控制器只在编程会话中接受刷写。先发 [0x10, 0x02] 进入编程会: This fictional controller accepts programming only in the programming session. Send [0x10, 0x02] to enter it, then [0x31, 0x01, 0xFF, 0x00] to erase the simulated storage.
en.第 0 拍进入编程会话，第 1 拍请求擦除；收到以 0x71 开头的擦除回答时交: Enter the programming session at tick 0 and request erase at tick 1. Output yes when an erase response beginning with 0x71 arrives; otherwise output 「—」.
en.用寄存卡数拍并选择请求；从回答位置 0 读取服务号。: Count ticks in a register and select the requests; read the response service at position 0.
en.擦除会让旧应用失效，直到完整下载、校验并重启。这里的例程标识和响应时序属于游戏模: Erasing invalidates the old application until download, verification and restart complete. The routine identifier and response timing are simulation choices.
en.擦除后请求下载。本模拟使用一个地址字节、两个长度字节；要写入四字节时，请求为 [: After erase, request a download. This simulation uses one address byte and two length bytes; a four-byte download request is [0x34, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00, 0x00, 0x04].
en.第 0 拍进入编程会话，第 1 拍擦除，第 2 拍申请四字节下载；从肯定回答 [: Enter programming at tick 0, erase at tick 1 and request a four-byte download at tick 2. Output the maximum block length from the positive response [0x74, 0x10, maximum block length].
en.按拍数选择三个请求；回答以 0x74 开头时，读取位置 2 的字节。: Select the three requests by tick; when the response starts with 0x74, read its byte at position 2.
en.下载回答给出单次传输允许的最大块长度；发送数据前需要遵守这个限制。: The download response gives the maximum length of a transfer block; the sender must respect it.
en.现在把前面的步骤串起来。测试软件是四字节 [1, 2, 3, 4]，模拟控制器允: Now join the steps. The test software is four bytes [1, 2, 3, 4], and the simulated controller permits at least four bytes per block including service and counter. Its checksum is a game-defined byte sum.
en.依次进入编程会话、擦除、申请四字节下载、发送两块、退出传输、请求校验并重启；每拍: In order, enter programming, erase, request a four-byte download, send two blocks, exit transfer, request verification and restart. Send one step per tick; the controller responds on the next tick. Output yes when restart is acknowledged.
en.两块分别为 [0x36, 1, 1, 2] 和 [0x36, 2, 3, 4]；: The blocks are [0x36, 1, 1, 2] and [0x36, 2, 3, 4]; exit is [0x37], verification is [0x31, 1, 0xFF, 1], and restart is [0x11, 1].
en.完整刷写要按顺序完成各阶段；这里固定了软件、时序与校验规则，真实刷写仍需处理更多: A complete flash follows each stage in order. This exercise fixes the software, timing and check; real flashing needs more conditions.
en.怎样把修好的软件送到控制器？: How can repaired software reach the controller?
en.发送长消息时，首帧送出后必须等接收方的流控许可。本练习中的接收方会按测试给定的延: After sending the first frame of a long message, the sender must wait for the receiver’s flow-control permission. In this exercise the receiver returns [0x30, block size, minimum separation] after the test’s configured delay.
en.每次给一条八字节消息：先发送首帧；收到以 0x30 开头的流控许可时，发送序号为: Each test supplies an eight-byte message. Send its first frame, then send consecutive frame number 1 when flow control beginning with 0x30 arrives. Send nothing on other ticks.
en.首帧携带长度与前六字节；从流控输入读取第一个字节，许可到达后再拼接剩余两个字节。: The first frame carries the length and first six bytes. Read the first flow-control byte and join the remaining two message bytes only after permission arrives.
en.等待许可是发送方和接收方之间的实际交互。这个练习只发一个后续帧，块大小与帧间隔会: Waiting for permission is an actual sender–receiver interaction. This exercise sends one consecutive frame; block size and separation come later.
en.模拟刷写发送第一块后，第 4 拍发生断电。控制器重新启动时旧应用仍无效，未完成的: The simulated device loses power at tick 4 after receiving its first block. On restart the old application is still invalid, and the interrupted download cannot simply continue.
en.前四拍开始刷写并发送第一块，第 4 拍不发送；断电后重新进入编程会话、擦除并完整: Start programming and send the first block in the first four ticks; send nothing at tick 4. After power loss, re-enter programming, erase and send all four bytes, then exit, verify and restart. Output yes when restart is acknowledged.
en.断电后先重做会话、擦除和下载申请，块计数重新从 1 开始；其余步骤与完整刷写相同: After power loss, repeat session entry, erase and download request; restart the block counter at 1. The remaining steps match the complete programming sequence.
en.断电后控制器保留未完成状态，但不能把半写入的应用当作有效应用；重新刷写并通过校验: After power loss the controller retains incomplete data but cannot treat a partially written application as valid. A fresh flash and successful verification are needed.
en.这次软件长度和控制器返回的块上限都会变化。最大块长度包含服务号和块计数；每块的数: This time the software length and the controller’s block limit vary. The maximum block length includes the service byte and block counter, leaving the limit minus two bytes for data.
en.模拟控制器的下载长度使用两个字节，块计数从 1 开始，255 之后回到 0。这里: The simulated download length uses two bytes. Block counters start at 1 and wrap from 255 to 0. Each step still receives a successful response on the next tick; the byte-sum check and routine identifiers are game rules.
en.用寄存卡保存阶段、块上限、当前偏移和块计数。每次取剩余字节数与块数据容量中较小的: Use registers for the stage, block limit, current offset and block counter. Take the smaller of remaining bytes and block-data capacity; increment the counter and AND with 255.
en.可变长度的软件需要按实际块上限分段；块计数回绕、最后一块不足容量时也要正确处理。: Variable-length software must be segmented to the actual block limit, including counter wrap and a short final block. This exercise still does not handle waiting, rejection or interrupted transfers.
en.封装刷写电路后，让它处理另一组软件与块上限，确认每个实例拥有自己的阶段和计数。: After packaging the programming circuit, use it with a different image and block limit; each instance maintains its own stage and counters.
en.使用模拟刷写器完成软件下载、校验与重启，并交出请求和完成结果。: Use the simulated programmer to download, verify and restart, forwarding its request and completion outputs.
en.封装件运行的是你搭建的电路；当前仍限定每一步按时成功。: The packaged part runs the circuit you built; it currently assumes each step succeeds on time.
en.流控中的最小间隔限制相邻后续帧的发送时刻。在这个模拟中间隔按游戏拍数计，发送之后: The minimum separation in flow control limits when consecutive frames may be sent. In this simulation separation is measured in game ticks; after a send, wait until the interval has elapsed.
en.收到设置时记住间隔。交出本拍是否可以发送；每次「已发送」为 1 后，等够指定拍数: Remember the separation when set. Output whether sending is permitted this tick; after each “sent” pulse, wait the specified number of ticks. Separations 0 and 1 both permit sending on the next tick.
en.用寄存卡保存间隔和剩余等待拍数。发送之后从间隔减一开始倒数，倒到零就可以再发。: Use registers for the interval and remaining wait. After a send start counting down from separation minus one; at zero another send is allowed.
en.后续帧之间的等待可以封装成独立元件；它只判断时间，发送许可和块大小仍需另行处理。: The delay between consecutive frames can be packaged as its own part. It checks time only; permission and block size still need separate handling.
en.保存流控间隔，在每次发送后等待指定拍数；输出本拍是否满足间隔。: Stores a flow-control separation and waits the specified number of ticks after each send; outputs whether the current tick meets the interval.
en.按流控发送长消息: Send a message under flow control
en.长消息可能有多个后续帧。接收方的流控给出块大小与最小间隔；块大小为 0 表示不再: A long message may need several consecutive frames. Flow control provides a block size and minimum separation: 0 means no further block waits; otherwise wait for a new grant after each block.
en.这个模拟按拍计算间隔，每个流控都允许继续，帧不填充。发送过程同时维护消息偏移、序: This simulation measures separation in ticks, grants continue-to-send only, and sends frames without padding. The sender tracks message offset, sequence, remaining block credit and permission.
en.发送消息首帧后等待流控；按块大小与最小间隔逐帧发送其余字节。块结束后等下一次许可: After the first frame wait for flow control, then send the remaining bytes according to the block size and minimum separation. Wait for a new grant at each block boundary; sequence numbers start at 1 and wrap modulo 16.
en.用后续帧间隔元件控制时机；用寄存卡分别保存偏移、序号、块剩余数和许可。块大小 0: Use the consecutive-frame gap part for timing. Registers can hold offset, sequence, remaining credit and permission. Represent unlimited block size by a value outside 0–255.
en.发送方和接收方根据流控协调进度；这个元件只处理正常许可，尚未处理等待、溢出和超时: Sender and receiver coordinate progress through flow control. This part handles successful grants only, not wait, overflow or timeout.
en.按模拟流控许可、块大小与拍数间隔发送一条长消息；支持序号回绕，当前仅处理继续发送: Sends one long message under the simulated flow-control grants, block size and tick separation; wraps sequence numbers and currently handles continue-to-send only.
en.封装发送电路，再让它与新的模拟接收方交换一条消息。: Package the sending circuit, then exchange another message with a new simulated receiver.
en.使用长消息发送元件，按接收方流控发送消息中的所有帧。: Use the long-message sender to send every frame under the receiver’s flow control.
en.把消息、流控数据和流控就绪标志接入元件，再转交它的帧数据。: Connect the message, flow-control data and ready signal, then forward its frame output.
en.封装件运行学习者搭出的发送电路，状态属于各自的元件实例。: The packaged part runs the circuit built by the learner, with independent state in each instance.
en.流控不总是立即允许发送。0x31 表示等待，0x32 表示接收方无法容纳消息；只: Flow control does not always grant permission immediately. 0x31 means wait and 0x32 means the receiver cannot accommodate the message; only 0x30 permits continuation.
en.将发送元件接到接收方；忽略等待帧，直到收到继续发送许可。收到溢出时不再发送后续帧: Connect the sender to the receiver. Ignore wait frames until a continue-to-send grant arrives. After overflow, send no consecutive frames.
en.先读取流控的第一个字节，只有它等于 0x30 且流控就绪时才给发送元件许可。: Read the first flow-control byte and enable the sender only when it is 0x30 and flow control is ready.
en.流控的状态决定继续、等待还是停止。这里接收方最多等待几次后给出结果，发送方超时仍: The flow-control status selects continue, wait or stop. Here the receiver eventually responds after a bounded number of waits; sender timeouts are still not handled.
en.首帧发出后，接收方可能一直不回答。发送方需要在等待上限到达时终止，而不是无限期等: After the first frame, a receiver may remain silent. The sender needs to abort at the waiting limit instead of waiting forever. This exercise handles timeout for the first flow-control grant.
en.用发送元件发首帧。若接收方在等待上限内给出继续许可就正常发送；若一直静默，到达上: Use the sender to send the first frame. If the receiver grants permission within the limit, send normally; if it remains silent, output yes once at the limit to abort.
en.用寄存卡数拍并记住是否已经收到流控；达到输入给出的上限且仍未收到时产生终止。: Count ticks in a register and remember whether flow control has arrived. At the input limit, abort if no flow control was received.
en.超时让不回答的接收方不能使发送永远停住。这个练习只处理首个许可，不处理后续块等待: A timeout prevents a silent receiver from stalling a sender forever. This exercise covers only the first grant, not timeouts between later blocks.
en.有的接收方要求每帧的数据区固定为八字节。实际消息较短时，可以在末尾添加填充值；消: Some receivers require exactly eight data bytes per frame. When the message is shorter, padding may fill the tail; the protocol header still defines the message length.
en.把每帧的数据序列补到八字节，填充值为 0。原来已有八字节时保持不变。: Pad each frame data sequence to eight bytes with 0; leave an existing eight-byte sequence unchanged.
en.用填充字节元件，长度接常数 8，填充值接常数 0。: Use the pad-bytes part, with constants 8 for length and 0 for the fill byte.
en.填充只补足帧长度，不增加消息本身的长度。: Padding fills the frame but does not extend the message.
en.按指定长度和填充值补足字节序列。: Fill a byte sequence to the requested length with the chosen byte.
en.空口「—」表示这一拍没有值；字节值 0 则是确实收到了一个值。这一区别让电路不会: 「—」 means no value on this tick; byte 0 means a value was actually received. This distinction prevents a valid zero from being mistaken for missing data.
en.检查每帧是否有第八个数据字节：有值时交出「是」，没有时交出「否」。字节为 0 也: Check whether each frame has an eighth data byte: output yes if present and no if absent. Byte 0 is present.
en.把第八个字节接入有值元件。: Connect the eighth byte to the value-present part.
en.值是否存在与值本身是多少是两回事；零和空序列都是值。: Whether a value exists is separate from its numeric value; zero and an empty sequence are both values.
en.判断输入是否有值，即使这个值是零。: Check whether an input is present, including when the value is zero.
