en.现在把发送和接收两块自己搭出的电路连起来：发送方依照模拟接收方的流控逐帧发送，接: Connect the sending and receiving circuits you built: the sender follows the simulated receiver’s flow control, while the reassembly circuit reconstructs the message from the frames.
en.转交发送元件的帧；将每个实际发送的帧补到八字节，送入重组元件。只有完整消息收齐时: Forward the sender’s frames. Pad each actual frame to eight bytes and feed it to the reassembler. Output the message only when it is complete.
en.用有值判断是否真的发送了帧，作为重组元件的接收允许；流控只有 0x30 才允许发: Use value-present to enable the reassembler only when a frame was sent; only flow-control status 0x30 grants the sender permission.
en.这条路径运行的是玩家搭出的发送和重组电路；总线位级控制器与诊断消息层之间仍需进一: This path runs the learner’s sending and reassembly circuits. The bit-level bus controller and diagnostic message layer still need further integration.
en.十七字节的车辆识别号装不下一帧。发送读取请求后，模拟控制器用首帧说明总长度，等到: A seventeen-byte vehicle identifier does not fit in one frame. After a read request, the simulated controller announces the total length in a first frame, waits for flow control, then sends the response in consecutive frames.
en.本练习以一拍一帧的方式交换，接收方用之前搭出的长消息重组元件。模拟仅覆盖一个肯定: This exercise exchanges one frame per tick and uses the long-message reassembler built earlier. The simulation covers one positive response and unlimited-block flow control; it is not yet connected to the bit-level controller.
en.先发送单帧读取请求 [0x03, 0x22, 0xF1, 0x90]。收到回答首: First send the single-frame read request [0x03, 0x22, 0xF1, 0x90]. When the response first frame arrives, send [0x30, 0, 0] as flow control. After reassembly, remove the first three bytes and output the seventeen-byte record.
en.用长消息重组元件接收回答帧；只有首帧到来时发送流控，收齐之后从位置 3 截取 1: Feed response frames to the long-message reassembler; send flow control only on the first frame, then take 17 bytes starting at position 3 once complete.
en.诊断请求、流控与玩家搭出的重组电路现在共同完成一次跨帧读取。这个场景仍未覆盖总线: The diagnostic request, flow control and the learner’s reassembly circuit now complete one multi-frame read. This scenario still excludes bus errors, multiple controllers and diagnostic timeouts.
en.按模拟控制器的块上限分段刷写软件；假定每一步按时成功，尚不处理拒绝、等待或断电。: Programs an image in blocks within the simulated controller’s limit; assumes each step succeeds on time and does not yet handle rejection, waiting or power loss. When programming is disabled it holds state and sends nothing.
en.进入编程、擦除、按软件长度申请下载；读取控制器给出的最大块长度，依次发送全部软件: Enter programming, erase and request a download for the software length. Read the controller’s block limit, send all software bytes in blocks with increasing counters, then exit, verify and restart. Output yes when restart is acknowledged. When programming is disabled, hold state and send nothing.
en.把控制器回答、软件序列和刷写允许接入封装件，分别转交它的请求和完成结果。: Connect the controller response, software image and programming enable to the packaged part, then forward its request and completion outputs.
en.把诊断和刷写放在同一个模拟控制器上：先读已确认故障和旧版本，再用自己搭出的刷写器: Combine diagnostics and programming on one simulated controller: first read confirmed faults and the old version, then update using the programmer you built. After restart, run a simulated driving cycle and recheck faults and version.
en.这个场景使用消息层、一个控制器和游戏定义的行驶例程；刷写器仍假定各步按时成功，还: This scenario uses a message layer, one controller and a game-defined driving routine. The programmer still assumes timely success; a complete vehicle, transport faults and multiple controllers are not simulated.
en.第 0、1 拍分别读已确认故障和版本；从第 2 拍启用刷写器。刷写完成后依次请求: At ticks 0 and 1 read confirmed faults and version; enable the programmer from tick 2. After programming completes, request a simulated driving cycle, read faults again, and read version again. Finally output [old version, new version, had confirmed faults before, has confirmed faults after].
en.先保存诊断结果，再让刷写器工作。用寄存卡记录刷写完成后的步骤；行驶例程请求是 [: Save the diagnostic results before starting the programmer. Use a register for the steps after programming; the driving routine request is [0x31, 1, 0xFE, 0].
en.一次更新需要把刷写结果与更新前后的诊断比较；即便修复了一个故障，也可能还有其他已: An update should be checked against diagnostics before and after programming; other confirmed faults may remain even after one is fixed.
en.模拟车辆有六个控制器，序号为 0 到 5。每拍向一个控制器读取软件版本，在线控制: The simulated vehicle has six controllers, numbered 0 to 5. Read the version from one controller per tick; online controllers reply on the next tick and offline controllers remain silent.
en.这是消息层练习，不模拟 CAN 仲裁、传输分帧或等待回答。版本 0 也是有效回答: This message-layer exercise does not simulate CAN arbitration, segmented transport or response waits. Version 0 is a valid response, so it cannot indicate whether a controller is online.
en.依次读取六个控制器的 0xF188 版本；在第 7 拍交出实际收到的 [序号,: Read DID 0xF188 from the six controllers in order. At tick 7 output the replies as [index, version, …]. Output an empty byte sequence if nobody replied.
en.用空字节序列初始化列表，仅当收到回答时追加回答来源和版本。: Initialize the list with an empty byte sequence and append the source and version only when a reply arrives.
en.回答标记区分静默和版本为零；扫描结果只记录实际收到的回答。: The response indicator distinguishes silence from version zero; the scan contains only actual replies.
en.空字节序列可作为逐步累积结果的起点。: An empty byte sequence provides the starting point for an accumulated result.
en.逐个读取六个模拟控制器并汇总回答的版本。: Read six simulated controllers in order and collect their version replies.
en.把扫描器封装起来，向使用者同时交出版本列表和是否有控制器回答。: Package the scanner and provide both the version list and whether any controller replied.
en.用扫描器逐个读取六个控制器，在结果出现时交出版本列表；同时交出是否有任何回答。: Use the scanner to read the six controllers. When the result appears, output the version list and whether anyone replied.
en.比较版本列表的长度和 0；空列表表示没有回答。: Compare the version list length with zero; an empty list means nobody replied.
en.即使没有任何控制器回答，也能明确报告空结果和「否」。: Even when nobody replies, the scan reports an empty result and no.
en.有些控制器只在扩展会话里给版本，有些会先回答「稍等」。逐个建立会话，读版本，再等: Some controllers provide their version only in an extended session, and some first reply with response pending. Open a session and read the version of each controller in order, waiting for the final response; offline controllers stay silent.
en.这仍是游戏定义的消息层：每次只处理一个控制器，下一拍没有会话回答就视为离线；稍等: This is a game-defined message layer: address one controller at a time and treat no session reply on the next tick as offline. After response pending, the controller sends further pending or the final reply on successive ticks.
en.按序号逐个请求扩展会话。收到会话回答后读取 0xF188；收到 0x7F 时继续: Request an extended session from each controller in order. After its session response, read 0xF188; keep waiting on 0x7F, record [index, version] on the positive reply, and skip a controller that does not answer the session request. Output the list when finished.
en.用阶段寄存卡区分请求会话、请求版本、等待最终回答和交出结果；不要把稍等当成最终答: Use a phase register for session request, version request, waiting for the final reply and output. Do not treat response pending as the final answer.
en.每个控制器的会话独立；处理稍等时，扫描器必须继续等实际的版本回答。: Each controller has its own session; the scanner must keep waiting for the actual version after a pending response.
en.逐个进入扩展会话，读取版本，再读取状态位含已确认的故障码。体检报告每条记录为 [: Open an extended session on each controller, read its version, then read faults whose status includes confirmed. Each report entry is [controller index, version, has a confirmed fault].
en.控制器可能离线、要求扩展会话或先回答稍等；本关仍是一次处理一个控制器的消息层模型: A controller may be offline, require an extended session or reply pending first. This message-layer model still handles one controller at a time.
en.依次体检六个控制器：先进入扩展会话，再读版本并等待最终回答，最后用 [0x19,: Examine the six controllers in order: open an extended session, read and wait for the final version reply, then request confirmed faults with [0x19, 2, 8]. Output a report for online controllers.
en.在版本回答到达后保存版本，再请求故障；故障回答除了三个字节的头部以外有记录时，表: Save the version when its response arrives, then request faults. A fault response longer than its three-byte header contains confirmed records.
en.体检同时保留在线控制器、软件版本和已确认故障状态；未确认的故障不会被计入。: The examination retains online controllers, versions and confirmed fault status; unconfirmed faults do not count.
en.逐个读取六个模拟控制器的版本与已确认故障状态。: Read the versions and confirmed fault status of six simulated controllers in order.
en.封装体检仪，除了完整报告，再给出是否有任何控制器报出已确认故障。: Package the examiner and provide both the full report and whether any controller reported a confirmed fault.
en.用体检仪交出报告，并在报告出现时交出是否存在已确认故障。: Use the examiner to output the report and, when it appears, whether there are any confirmed faults.
en.报告每三字节一条，第三字节是该控制器的故障状态；缺少的记录按 0 处理。: Every three bytes make one report entry; the third is its fault flag. Treat missing entries as zero.
en.总状态和逐控制器报告一起呈现，才不会把一个控制器的结果当成整车结果。: Show the overall status alongside individual reports, so one controller is not mistaken for the whole vehicle.
en.按依赖更新两个控制器: Update two controllers in dependency order
en.模拟车辆的控制器 1 依赖控制器 0：只有 0 成功刷写并重启后，1 才允许进入: In this simulated vehicle controller 1 depends on controller 0: 1 may enter programming only after 0 has been programmed and restarted successfully. Each controller has its own image and block limit.
en.本关仍使用游戏定义的消息层和简化刷写规则，假定每一步按时成功；真实车辆可能有不同: This exercise still uses a game-defined message layer and simplified programming, assuming each step succeeds on time. Real vehicles may have different dependencies and security requirements.
en.用两个刷写器实例，先更新控制器 0，再更新控制器 1；两者重启后依次读取 0xF: Use two programmer instances to update controller 0 first, then controller 1. After both restart, read 0xF188 from each and output their new versions.
en.用寄存卡记下第一个刷写器完成；两个封装件分别连接自己的软件。第二个完成后再请求两: Use a register to remember when the first programmer completes; connect each packaged part to its own image. After the second completes, read the versions in order.
en.两个刷写器各自保存阶段和块计数；依赖顺序保证前置控制器已经成功重启。: Each programmer keeps its own phase and block counter; the dependency order ensures the prerequisite controller has restarted successfully.
en.先用自己搭的体检仪记录两个在线控制器的版本和已确认故障，再按依赖顺序刷写两个控制: First use the examiner you built to record versions and confirmed faults on the two online controllers, then program the two controllers in dependency order. After restart, run a game-defined driving cycle and reread faults and versions.
en.这是消息层综合练习：控制器 0 和 1 在线，其余四个离线；所有步骤假定按时成功: This integrated message-layer exercise has controllers 0 and 1 online and the other four offline. All steps assume timely successful responses, and the driving cycle clears only faults specified by the test. It does not simulate real roads or the physical bus.
en.先体检，再先后刷写控制器 0 和 1；两者重启后分别运行 [0x31, 1, 0: First examine the vehicle, then program controllers 0 and 1 in order. After both restart, run [0x31, 1, 0xFE, 0] on each and reread confirmed faults and versions. Output [old version 0, old version 1, new version 0, new version 1, fault 0 before, fault 1 before, fault 0 after, fault 1 after].
en.用体检报告启动刷写器并保存旧结果。第二个刷写器完成后，按顺序发送两个行驶请求、两: Start the programmers from the examination report and save the old results. When the second programmer completes, request the two driving cycles, two fault reads and two version reads in order; save the responses in registers.
en.复查应比较更新前后的结果；修复指定故障后，其他已确认故障仍可能存在。: Compare the results before and after the update; other confirmed faults can remain after the specified fault is fixed.
en.逐个列出已确认故障码: List confirmed fault codes by controller
en.诊断回答中每条故障记录占四个字节：三个字节的故障码和一个状态字节。每个在线控制器: Each diagnostic fault record has four bytes: a three-byte fault code and one status byte. Each online controller can have zero or more records.
en.按体检顺序请求版本和已确认故障。交出每个在线控制器的一组 [序号, 条数, 故障: Request versions and confirmed faults in examination order. Output one group per online controller as [index, count, three fault-code bytes, status, …]; include index and 0 for an empty group.
en.去掉故障回答的三个字节头部；剩余长度除以四得到条数，再把序号、条数和全部记录拼接: Remove the three-byte header from the fault response. Divide the remaining length by four for the count, then concatenate the index, count and all records.
en.每组带有控制器序号和记录条数，因此多条记录和没有故障都能区分。: Each group carries its controller index and record count, distinguishing multiple records from none.
en.逐个控制器收集已确认故障码及状态。: Collect confirmed fault codes and statuses by controller.
en.复用故障码扫描器，根据每组的条数判断整车是否有已确认故障，同时保留每条原始故障码: Reuse the fault-code scanner to determine whether the vehicle has any confirmed faults while keeping each raw fault code.
en.交出分组故障码列表，并在结果出现时交出是否存在已确认故障。: Output the grouped fault-code list and, when it appears, whether any confirmed fault exists.
en.从每组的条数算出下一组的位置：跳过序号、条数和每条四字节记录；最多需要处理六组。: Use each group count to find the next group: skip the index, count and four bytes per record. There are at most six groups.
en.列表保留故障码和所属控制器，总状态则汇总所有组。: The list retains each fault code and its controller, while the overall status combines all groups.
en.逐帧比较车速与轮速。一次短暂不一致不一定值得截取；这里把连续三帧不一致定义为持续: Compare vehicle and wheel speed frame by frame. A brief mismatch may not be worth capturing; here three consecutive mismatched frames define a sustained mismatch.
en.第一次出现连续三帧车速与轮速不同，恰在第三帧交出「是」；其他帧交出「否」，后续不: Output yes exactly on the third frame of the first run of three mismatched speed readings. Output no on other frames and do not trigger again.
en.用寄存卡数连续不一致的帧，遇到一致就清零；再记住是否已经触发。: Count consecutive mismatched frames in a register and reset on a match; also remember whether the trigger has already fired.
en.把持续条件和只触发一次分开记，才能从一段数据中找到第一次事件。: Remember the sustained condition separately from whether it has fired, so the first event can be found in a stream.
en.在车速和轮速首次连续三帧不一致时触发一次。: Trigger once when vehicle and wheel speed first differ for three consecutive frames.
en.触发点本身不足以说明事件。保存触发前一帧、触发帧和后一帧的车速、轮速，并记录触发: The trigger alone is not enough context. Save the vehicle and wheel speed in the frame before, at and after the trigger, and record the trigger frame’s bus start time.
en.这里用三帧的小窗口练习触发记录；时间以总线位拍计，不代表真实道路上的分钟日志。: This exercise uses a small three-frame window; time is measured in bus bit ticks and does not represent a real multi-minute road log.
en.用持续不一致监视器找到首次事件；在后一帧交出触发时间，以及前一帧、触发帧和后一帧: Use the sustained mismatch monitor to find the first event. On the following frame output the trigger time and vehicle and wheel speeds from the previous, trigger and following frames. Output 「—」 on other frames.
en.每帧保存上一帧；触发时锁存上一帧、当前帧和时间。下一帧交出这些值及当前输入。: Save the previous frame on every tick. At the trigger, latch the previous frame, current frame and time. On the next frame output those values and the current inputs.
en.事件前后的上下文让一次触发更容易检查；这个短窗口还不是完整的试车日志。: Context around an event helps investigate the trigger; this short window is not a complete road log.
en.把低字节和高字节合成一个无符号值。: Combine the low and high bytes into an unsigned value.
en.把数值写成双字节: Write a value as two bytes
en.编码把数值拆回字节。本关约定一个 0 到 65535 的无符号整数，低字节在前；: Encoding splits a value back into bytes. This exercise uses an unsigned integer from 0 to 65535, low byte first; it produces bytes without transmitting a bus frame.
en.每拍将输入数值拆成低字节和高字节。: Split the input value into low and high bytes on each tick.
en.低字节保留最低八位；右移八位得到高字节。: Keep the lowest eight bits for the low byte; shift right by eight for the high byte.
en.编码和解码必须使用相同的字节顺序；边界值也应能完整往返。: Encoding and decoding must use the same byte order, including at the boundaries.
en.把无符号双字节数值拆成低字节和高字节。: Split an unsigned two-byte value into low and high bytes.
en.把自己搭的编码器和解码器接在一起，检查字节顺序能否还原输入。: Connect the encoder and decoder you built to check whether their byte order recovers the input.
en.交出编码后的低、高字节，并把它们交给解码器，还原原始数值。: Output the encoded low and high bytes, then feed them to the decoder to recover the original value.
en.编码器的低字节接解码器的第一个输入，高字节接第二个输入。: Connect the encoder’s low byte to the decoder’s first input and its high byte to the second.
en.往返测试能发现字节顺序和边界错误；实际发送还需要把字节装入帧并交给总线。: A round trip can reveal byte-order and boundary errors; actual transmission still needs the bytes packed into a frame and sent to the bus.
en.把体检仪和故障码扫描器接在同一组回答上。它们按相同顺序请求控制器，分别汇总版本和: Connect the examiner and fault-code scanner to the same responses. They request controllers in the same order and independently collect versions and each confirmed fault code.
en.这六个模拟控制器中可能有人离线、要求扩展会话或先回答稍等。所有请求仍按消息层顺序: These six simulated controllers may be offline, require an extended session or first reply pending. Requests are still handled sequentially at the message layer; functional addressing and interleaved multi-frame replies are not simulated.
en.交出逐控制器的版本与故障状态报告，以及按控制器分组的已确认故障码。只让一套请求连: Output the version and fault-status report by controller, and the confirmed fault codes grouped by controller. Connect only one set of requests to the simulated vehicle, while both packaged parts read the same responses.
en.两个封装件都用回答来源、内容和收到标记；把其中一个的请求送给车辆，分别交出它们的: Give both packaged parts the response source, content and received indicator; send one part’s requests to the vehicle and output their reports separately.
en.一张体检报告既要列出在线控制器和版本，也要保留故障码；离线与没有故障是不同结果。: An examination report should list online controllers and versions as well as preserve the fault codes; offline is different from having no faults.
en.这次只对一个数据字节算游戏定义的 CRC-8：初值为 0，多项式为 0x07，不: Calculate a game-defined CRC-8 for one data byte: initial value 0, polynomial 0x07, no reflection and no final XOR. Shift the most significant bit out first; XOR 0x07 when that bit is 1.
en.对每帧的第一个字节计算这套 CRC-8，交出一个字节的结果。: Calculate this CRC-8 for the first data byte of each frame and output one byte.
en.把输入作为寄存值，重复八次：记录最高位，把值左移一位并保留低八位；若移出的位是: Start with the input and repeat eight times: record the top bit, shift left and keep the low eight bits; XOR with 7 if the bit shifted out was 1.
en.CRC 算法由多项式、初值和位序等共同决定；不能仅凭名字假定不同系统使用同一套规: A CRC algorithm is determined by its polynomial, initial value, bit order and other parameters; the name alone does not guarantee the same rules across systems.
en.按游戏给定的 0x07 多项式计算单字节 CRC-8。: Calculate the game-defined single-byte CRC-8 using polynomial 0x07.
en.一条报文既可能数据被改坏，也可能漏过一帧。将 CRC 和四位滚动计数器一起检查；: A frame may contain corrupted data or follow a missed frame. Check its CRC and four-bit rolling counter together; each received count becomes the starting point for the next comparison.
en.允许为 1 时检查数据字节的 CRC 和计数器：两者都正确才为有效。第一帧只检查: When enabled, check the CRC and counter: a frame is valid only if both are correct. Check only the CRC on the first frame; when disabled, hold state and output 「—」.
en.复用单字节 CRC-8；用寄存卡记住上一计数，15 后按 16 回绕。: Reuse the single-byte CRC-8 and store the previous count in a register, wrapping after 15.
en.校验数据内容和检查帧序列分别发现不同的问题；两个条件都成立才算通过。: Data integrity and frame sequence expose different problems; both conditions must hold.
en.同时检查单字节 CRC 和四位滚动计数器。: Check a single-byte CRC and four-bit rolling counter together.
en.总线上有不同标识符的报文。监视器只应让目标标识符更新计数状态；其他报文不能打乱它: The bus carries different identifiers. Only the target identifier should update the monitor’s counter; unrelated frames must not disturb its sequence.
en.只检查标识符 0x120 的报文，交出其有效状态；其他报文交出「—」且不能改变监: Check only frames with identifier 0x120 and output their validity. Output 「—」 for other frames and do not let them change the monitor state.
en.比较标识符，再将结果接到监视器的检查允许。: Compare the identifier and connect the result to the monitor’s enable.
en.每个标识符需要独立的监视状态；无关报文不应影响目标的计数。: Each identifier needs its own monitoring state; unrelated frames must not affect the target counter.
en.仅在报文到来时比较间隔，无法在它迟迟不来时给出超时结果。这里增加独立的时钟检查点: Checking intervals only when a frame arrives cannot report a timeout while the frame is missing. This exercise adds independent clock checks; time remains measured in bus bit ticks.
en.目标报文到达时更新最后时间；距离最后一次到达不超过期限时为有效，超过期限后为无效: Update the last time when a target frame arrives. It is fresh when no more than the deadline has elapsed, and stale after that. Before the first target frame it is stale.
en.在每个报文或时钟检查点，判断目标标识符是否仍在期限内。其他标识符不能重置计时。: At every frame or clock check, determine whether the target identifier is still within its deadline. Other identifiers must not reset the timer.
en.保存目标帧的时间，用当前时间减去它；没有收到过目标帧时直接输出否。恰好达到期限仍: Save the target frame’s time and subtract it from the current time; output no before the first target frame. The exact deadline is still fresh.
en.时钟检查点让缺失报文在下一帧到来之前被发现；目标标识符和期限都可由输入改变。: Clock checks detect a missing frame before another arrives; the target identifier and deadline can both be supplied as inputs.
en.按目标标识符和期限判断报文是否仍然新鲜。: Determine whether a target identifier arrived within a supplied deadline.
en.同一条报文既要按时到达，也要有正确的 CRC 和计数。计时器在时钟检查点持续判断: A frame must arrive on time and have a correct CRC and counter. The timer continues at clock checks; the content monitor checks only actual target frames.
en.接入计时器和报文监视器，在每个观察时刻交出是否超时；仅在目标报文到达时交出 CR: Connect the timer and frame monitor. At every observation output whether the frame is fresh; output CRC and counter validity only when the target frame arrives.
en.只把目标帧的选择信号接到内容监视器；时钟检查点不是帧，不能推进计数。: Enable the content monitor only for target frames; a clock check is not a frame and must not advance the counter.
en.超时和内容错误是不同的观察：没有新帧时仍可报超时，而 CRC 与计数只对实际收到: Timeout and content errors are separate observations: a missing frame can time out, while CRC and count are checked only on received target frames.
en.收到首帧之后，接收方不能永远等待后续帧。使用独立时钟检查点；超过期限就放弃这条未: After a first frame, the receiver cannot wait forever for the next one. Use independent clock checks: after the deadline abandon the incomplete message, and do not let a late consecutive frame complete it.
en.本练习限定正常的首帧和顺序正确的后续帧，不模拟流控交换；期限以总线位拍计，恰好到: This exercise covers normal first frames and in-order consecutive frames without a flow-control exchange. Deadlines are measured in bus bit ticks; a frame at the exact deadline is accepted.
en.使用重组元件接收目标标识符的长消息。自上一帧起超过期限时输出一次超时；丢弃迟到的: Use the reassembler for long messages from the target identifier. Report a timeout once the time since the last frame exceeds the deadline; discard late consecutive frames and allow a new first frame to start again.
en.用寄存卡记录是否正在接收和上一帧时间；超时后关掉重组元件的接收允许，直到新的首帧: Store whether reception is active and the last frame time in registers. After a timeout disable the reassembler until a new first frame.
en.时间到期会终止旧消息；后续的新首帧可以建立独立的新消息。: A deadline ends the old message; a later first frame can establish a new one.
en.按期限重组单个标识符的长消息，超时后等待新首帧。: Reassemble long messages from one identifier with a deadline; after timeout wait for a new first frame.
en.两个控制器的回答可以交错。每个接收器必须独立保存重组内容和最后接收时间，一个超时: Replies from two controllers may interleave. Each receiver must independently retain reassembly and last-reception time, so one timeout cannot cancel the other.
en.分别重组 0x7E8 和 0x7E9 的消息，并分别报告各自的接收超时；时钟检查: Reassemble messages from 0x7E8 and 0x7E9 and report each timeout separately; clock checks apply to both receivers.
en.放两个有超时的重组器，给它们相同的帧和时间，目标标识符分别设为 0x7E8 和: Place two timed reassemblers, give them the same frames and time, and set their target identifiers to 0x7E8 and 0x7E9.
en.重组状态和计时状态都属于回答者；一方超时不影响另一方。: Both reassembly and timing state belong to the responder; one timeout does not affect the other.
en.后续流控也可能失联: Later flow control can also go silent
en.块大小为 1 时，每发一帧后续帧都要再等一次流控。接收方可能批准了第一块，却在下: With block size 1, each consecutive frame is followed by another flow-control wait. A receiver may grant the first block and then go silent before the next.
en.本关只处理块大小为 1、首次流控按时到达且后续流控只有继续或静默的情况；等待上限: This exercise covers block size 1, a timely first grant and later flow control that either continues or stays silent. The deadline uses game ticks.
en.用发送器发长消息。每次发送后续帧后，如果还有数据，就开始等待下一个流控；接收方沉: Send the long message with the sender. After each consecutive frame, if data remains, wait for another flow-control response; output one abort when silence reaches the deadline.
en.记录已发送的字节数，判断发送后是否还有数据。发送后续帧时从零开始计时；收到流控后: Track how many data bytes have been sent to determine whether more remain. Start a counter at zero on a consecutive frame and clear the wait when flow control arrives.
en.每一个数据块之后都可能需要新的流控；计时从需要等待的那一帧开始。: Every data block may require another flow-control response; the timer starts at the frame that begins the wait.
en.谁都能拉低: Anyone can pull the line low
en.两个人共用一根线。只要有人说显性 0，线就是 0；两人都说隐性 1，线才是 1。: Two people share one line. If either says dominant 0, the line is 0; it is 1 only when both say recessive 1.
en.对每组节点说的位，逐拍写出总线上的位。直接连续填写 0 和 1，例如 0101。: For each pair of node bit sequences, write the bus bits tick by tick. Enter the 0s and 1s consecutively, for example 0101.
en.每一拍分别比较两个节点；只要出现一个 0，就写 0。: Compare both nodes at each tick: write 0 whenever either says 0.
en.共用总线的值由所有节点共同决定：显性会盖过隐性。: All nodes determine the shared line together: dominant overrides recessive.
en.一个字节有八位；每四位可以写成一个十六进制数字。: A byte has eight bits; each group of four bits can be written as one hexadecimal digit.
en.把每个十进制数写成八位二进制，再写两个十六进制数字，两部分之间留一个空格，例如: Write each decimal number as eight binary bits, followed by two hexadecimal digits separated by a space, for example 00001010 0A.
en.先补足八位，再将左、右各四位分别换成十六进制。: Pad to eight bits, then convert each four-bit group to hexadecimal.
en.固定位宽保留了前导零；二进制与十六进制只是同一数值的不同写法。: Fixed width preserves leading zeroes; binary and hexadecimal are two ways to write the same value.
en.在线空闲之后找帧起始: Find a frame start after idle
en.总线连续至少 11 位隐性后，紧接着的第一个显性位可作为新帧起始。位序号从 0: After at least 11 consecutive recessive bits, the next dominant bit can mark a new frame start. Bit positions start at 0.
en.写出每条位序列中符合条件的所有显性位序号，用逗号分隔；没有符合条件的位时写 -。: Write every qualifying dominant-bit position for each sequence, separated by commas; write - if none qualify.
en.从序列开头逐位数连续的 1；遇到 0 时检查前面是否至少有 11 个 1，然后重: Count consecutive 1s from the beginning. At each 0, check whether at least 11 came before it, then reset the count.
en.不是每个显性位都是帧起始；必须先看到足够长的空闲。: Not every dominant bit begins a frame; it must follow a sufficiently long idle run.
en.一根共享的线如何表示信息？: How does a shared line represent information?
en.保存首次持续不一致前后的速度样本和触发时间。: Save speed samples around the first sustained mismatch and its trigger time.
en.封装体检仪时加入启动输入：启动之前保持状态，收到启动后按原来的顺序完成一次体检。: Add a start input to the examiner: hold state until started, then complete one examination in the same order.
en.启动为 0 时不请求也不推进；第一次收到启动后，逐个读取控制器的版本和已确认故障: While start is 0, do not request or advance. After the first start signal, read versions and confirmed faults from the controllers in order and output the examination report.
en.先锁存启动信号，再用它控制请求、报告和各寄存卡的更新。体检开始后即使启动信号结束: Latch the start signal, then use it to control requests, the report and register updates. Once started, continue even if the signal ends.
en.启动信号把事件记录和诊断连接起来；一次触发即可完成整个体检。: The start signal joins event recording to diagnosis; one trigger completes the whole examination.
en.收到启动后逐个读取六个模拟控制器的版本和已确认故障状态。: After a start signal, read versions and confirmed fault status from six simulated controllers.
en.从记录到更新与复查: From recording to update and recheck
en.用触发窗口记录仪找到车速和轮速首次持续不一致的时刻；记录完成后启动体检，按依赖顺: Use the trigger-window recorder to find the first sustained mismatch between vehicle and wheel speed. Once the window is recorded, start the examination, update two controllers in dependency order, then simulate a drive and recheck.
en.这是游戏定义的简化综合场景：速度样本、诊断和刷写都按游戏拍推进；两个控制器在线，: This is a simplified game-defined scenario: speed samples, diagnostics and programming advance in game ticks; two controllers are online, all replies succeed on time, and the driving cycle clears only specified faults. It is not a complete physical-bus or real-vehicle simulation.
en.交出触发前、触发时和触发后的六个速度值；之后体检、先后刷写控制器 0 和 1、运: Output the six speed values from before, at and after the trigger. Then examine the vehicle, program controllers 0 and 1 in order, run their simulated driving cycles and recheck. Finally output the trigger tick and versions and confirmed-fault status before and after.
en.把游戏拍计数和速度样本接到触发窗口记录仪；记录出现时启动体检仪。之后复用两个刷写: Connect the game-tick counter and speed samples to the trigger-window recorder; start the examiner when a record appears. Then reuse two programmers and save the recheck results.
en.从事件上下文出发，再比较更新前后的诊断结果；指定故障修复后，其他故障仍可能存在。: Start from the event context, then compare diagnostics before and after the update; other faults may remain after the specified fault is fixed.
en.这次不逐个寻址：目标 255 是本游戏的功能广播地址，一次读取请求发给全部控制器: Instead of addressing controllers one by one, send one read request to the game’s functional broadcast target 255. Online controllers reply in index order; offline controllers remain silent.
en.这里是游戏定义的消息层：每个在线控制器下一拍起依次交出一条回答；不模拟物理仲裁、: This game-defined message layer delivers one online controller response per tick beginning on the next tick. It does not simulate physical arbitration, interleaved multi-frame replies or response waits.
en.在第 0 拍向广播目标 255 发送一次 0xF188 读取请求；在第 7 拍交: At tick 0 send one 0xF188 read to broadcast target 255. At tick 7 output actual replies as [index, version, …], or an empty sequence if nobody replied.
en.广播只发送一次；仍要用收到回答标记逐条收集来源与版本，版本 0 也是有效值。: Broadcast once, then use the received indicator to collect source and version for each reply. Version 0 is valid.
en.功能广播一次发问、逐条收集回答；在线判断依靠实际回答而不是版本值。: Functional broadcast asks once and collects replies individually; online status depends on actual responses, not the version value.
en.广播一次版本读取请求并汇总六个模拟控制器的回答。: Broadcast one version read and collect replies from six simulated controllers.
en.封装广播扫描器，除了版本列表，还要告诉使用者是否收到了任何回答。: Package the broadcast scanner and report both the version list and whether anyone replied.
en.用广播扫描器发一次请求；结果出现时交出版本列表和是否收到回答。: Use the broadcast scanner to send one request. When the result appears, output the version list and whether any reply arrived.
en.空版本列表表示没有回答；有一条版本为 0 的记录也不是空列表。: An empty list means nobody replied; a version-zero record is not an empty list.
en.空结果、版本为 0 和控制器离线仍是不同情况。: An empty result, version zero and an offline controller remain different cases.
en.这次不直接读取逐帧世界的字段：把自己搭出的逐位 CAN 控制器接到总线，从它接收: Instead of reading fields directly from the frame-level world, connect the bit-level CAN controller you built and decode the speed from its received data.
en.目标帧标识符为 0x2A5，数据恰有一个字节，车速等于该字节的两倍。只在接收结果: The target identifier is 0x2A5 and its data is exactly one byte; speed is twice that byte. Output speed only when a reception result is ready and valid; other frames and errors produce no speed.
en.本关沿用控制器原型的限定测试：一次初始仲裁、受控错误、被动暂停及下线恢复；它不是: This exercise retains the controller prototype’s scoped tests: one initial arbitration, controlled errors, passive suspension and bus-off recovery. It is not a complete model of all CAN scenarios.
en.连接自己的 CAN 控制器并转交它的收发和状态结果；保存接收到的标识符、长度与字: Connect your CAN controller and forward its transmit, receive and status results. Save the received identifier, length and byte, and output decoded speed only when the target frame is successfully received.
en.逐拍保存控制器输出的标识符、长度和字节；收到结果就绪后同时检查结果种类、标识符和: Save the controller’s identifier, length and data byte as they appear. When a result is ready, check the result type, identifier and length before outputting twice the byte.
en.高层信号来自玩家搭出的逐位控制器，错误帧不会被当成车速；其他逐帧练习仍使用单独的: The higher-level signal comes from the player-built bit-level controller, so an error frame is not treated as speed. Other frame-level exercises still use a separate simplified scheduler.
en.行驶后的模拟车速和轮速都必须在 0 到 100 之间，差值不超过 2；两个新版本: After the simulated drive, both vehicle and wheel speed must be between 0 and 100 and differ by no more than 2. The recheck passes only if the two new versions match and no confirmed faults remain.
en.交出触发前、触发时和触发后的六个速度值；之后体检、先后刷写控制器 0 和 1、运: Output the six speed values from before, at and after the trigger. Then examine the vehicle, program controllers 0 and 1 in order, run their simulated driving cycles and recheck. Finally output the trigger tick, versions and confirmed-fault status before and after, and whether the recheck passes.
en.把游戏拍计数和速度样本接到触发窗口记录仪；记录出现时启动体检仪。复用两个刷写器后: Connect the game-tick counter and speed samples to the trigger-window recorder and start the examiner when a record appears. After using two programmers, compare the new versions, rechecked faults, and the speed range and difference.
en.从事件上下文出发，再同时检查版本、故障和行驶后信号；任何一项不符合条件都不能报通: Start from the event context, then check versions, faults and post-drive signals together; any unmet condition prevents a pass.
en.功能请求的交错长回答: Interleaved long replies to a functional request
en.向功能地址发一次读取请求，两个模拟控制器分别以 0x7E8 和 0x7E9 返回: Send one functional read. Two simulated controllers reply under 0x7E8 and 0x7E9 with 17-byte records; each reply spans multiple frames and the consecutive frames interleave.
en.首帧到达后，分别向对应控制器发送无限块流控 [0x30, 0, 0]，它才会继续: After each first frame, send unlimited-block flow control [0x30, 0, 0] to that controller before it continues. This uses game-defined fixed timing and eight-byte padding; other arbitration and timeouts are not simulated.
en.先发单帧功能请求 [3, 0x22, 0xF1, 0x90] 到目标 255。分: Send the single-frame functional request [3, 0x22, 0xF1, 0x90] to target 255. Send flow control for each first frame, reassemble replies by source, strip each positive-response header and output both 17-byte records.
en.用两个重组器分别处理两个标识符；首帧到达时将流控发回对应来源。完整消息的前三字节: Use two reassemblers, one per identifier; send flow control back to the corresponding source on its first frame. The first three message bytes are the response header.
en.一次功能请求可以产生多份长回答；流控和重组状态都属于各自的回答者。: One functional request can produce multiple long replies; flow control and reassembly state belong to each responder.
en.清除故障码只删除当前记录，并不证明故障已经修好。模拟行驶循环可以让测试指定的故障: Clearing trouble codes only removes the current records; it does not prove a fault is repaired. A simulated driving cycle can make a fault specified by the test recur.
en.本关使用游戏定义的行驶例程 [0x31, 1, 0xFE, 0]；它不是任何真实: This exercise uses the game-defined driving routine [0x31, 1, 0xFE, 0]; it is not the driving or diagnostic procedure of any real vehicle.
en.依次读取已确认故障、清除全部故障、再次读取、运行模拟行驶循环并再读一次。交出 [: Read confirmed faults, clear all faults, read again, run the simulated driving cycle and read once more. Output [count before clearing, count after clearing, count after driving].
en.故障回答的前三字节是头部，之后每条记录四字节。分别保存前两次的条数，最后拼成报告: The first three bytes of a fault response are a header and each record is four bytes. Save the first two counts, then combine them in the report.
en.清除后的空列表只能说明记录被清除；行驶后再次读取才能观察这个模拟故障是否复现。: An empty list after clearing only shows that records were cleared; reading again after driving shows whether this simulated fault recurred.
en.从 CAN 帧取出诊断回答: Extract a diagnostic reply from a CAN frame
en.把逐位 CAN 接收和单帧诊断格式接起来：脚本节点发送一个 0x7E8 帧，数据: Connect bit-level CAN reception to the single-frame diagnostic format: a scripted node sends a 0x7E8 frame whose data contains a four-byte positive response.
en.玩家搭出的控制器必须先验证整帧；随后检查单帧长度、肯定回答服务号和数据标识，再交: The player-built controller must first validate the whole frame; then check the single-frame length, positive service and data identifier before outputting the four-byte diagnostic message. Requests and replies are scripted here rather than a complete diagnostic session.
en.连接自己的 CAN 控制器。对成功接收的 0x7E8、五字节 CAN 数据 [4: Connect your CAN controller. For a successfully received 0x7E8 frame with five data bytes [4, 0x62, 0xF1, 0x90, value], output the last four bytes; output 「—」 for erroneous or differently formatted frames.
en.收到标识符时清空字节序列，逐个保存控制器交出的字节；结果就绪后先确认校验、标识符: Clear the byte sequence when an identifier arrives, then save each byte from the controller. When the result is ready, verify its status, identifier, length and diagnostic header.
en.逐位接收、CAN 校验与单帧诊断格式在这里真正连接；完整交互和多帧流控仍在其他关: Bit-level reception, CAN validation and single-frame diagnostic formatting are connected here; complete exchanges and multi-frame flow control remain separate simulations.
en.前面的关卡中，模拟控制器回答玩家。现在换个方向：玩家电路收到诊断请求，并用题目提: Earlier the simulated controller answered the player. Now reverse the direction: the player’s circuit receives diagnostic requests and constructs responses from the supplied records.
en.本关只处理三种完整格式：读取 0xF190、读取已确认故障 [0x19, 2,: This exercise handles only three complete formats: read 0xF190, read confirmed faults [0x19, 2, 8], and other service numbers. Data and already-confirmed fault records are supplied as inputs; sessions, segmentation and changes in fault status are not simulated.
en.收到 [0x22, 0xF1, 0x90] 时交出肯定回答和数据记录；其他 0x: For [0x22, 0xF1, 0x90], output the positive response and data record; for other 0x22 identifiers output [0x7F, 0x22, 0x31]. For [0x19, 2, 8], output [0x59, 2, 0xFF] and the fault records. For other services output [0x7F, service, 0x11]. Output 「—」 when no request arrives.
en.先取服务号，再检查读取请求中的两个标识字节；用字节序列拼接构造肯定和否定回答。: Read the service first, then check both identifier bytes on a read request; concatenate byte sequences to construct positive and negative responses.
en.诊断控制器既要对支持的服务给出约定格式，也要对不支持的请求说明原因。: A diagnostic controller needs both the agreed response format for supported services and a reason for unsupported requests.
en.把双字节编码器接到简化帧调度器：在固定周期请求发送三帧，并与其他节点的干净帧竞争: Connect the two-byte encoder to the simplified frame scheduler: request three frames at a fixed period while competing with other nodes’ clean frames.
en.时间以总线位拍计。调度器按标识符仲裁，失败的请求等到下一次帧间隔；这里不模拟错误: Time is measured in bus bit ticks. The scheduler arbitrates by identifier and a losing request waits for the next intermission; errors, missing acknowledgements and the player’s bit-level controller are not simulated here.
en.在第 0 拍、一个周期和两个周期时请求发送标识符 0x200 的帧，数据为输入数: At tick 0, one period and two periods, request a frame with identifier 0x200 and the input value encoded as low byte then high byte. Do not request a frame on other ticks.
en.用寄存卡计拍，分别比较 0、一个周期和两个周期；用自己搭的双字节编码器生成帧数据: Count ticks in a register and compare with 0, one period and two periods. Use the two-byte encoder you built for the frame data.
en.应用按周期提出发送请求，实际帧开始时间还取决于其他节点的仲裁和帧间隔。: An application requests periodic transmission, but the actual frame start depends on arbitration and other frames.
